{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "154", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a corporate accused does not appear in answer to a summons to answer to a charge for an indictable offence, the Magistrates' Court may conduct a committal proceeding in the absence of the accused if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "154", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the charge and the date of the committal mention hearing in relation to it have been brought to the notice of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "154", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that it is appropriate to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "154", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court conducts a committal proceeding in the absence of a corporate accused, the court may dispense with or vary any requirement imposed by or under this Chapter.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 155 repealed by No. 5/2025 s. 9.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "155", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 189, "rect": {"page": 189, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 509.0, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-19T09:52:53.557983+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "154", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Nothing in Chapter affects certain powers of DPP
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "156", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this Chapter affects the power of the DPP—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "156", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to file an indictment against a person for an offence if, on a committal proceeding conducted in relation to a charge for that offence, the Magistrates' Court ordered the person to be discharged on the charge; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "156", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to discontinue a prosecution under section 177, or not to take within the period prescribed by section 163 any step mentioned in that section, in relation to a charge on which a person was committed for trial.

heading: DPP may give directions for release of property tendered in evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If property is tendered in evidence during a committal proceeding and an accused is committed for trial for an offence with respect to the property, a person may apply in writing to the DPP for the release of the property.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On receipt of an application under subsection (1), the DPP may give directions in writing that the property be released to the applicant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The release of property under subsection (2) may be subject to a condition that the property released must be produced at the trial and to any other conditions that the DPP considers appropriate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP may require a person to whom property is released under this section to give an undertaking to comply with the conditions to which the release is subject.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person must not fail, without reasonable cause, to comply with an undertaking given by the person under subsection (4).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Penalty: Level 10 fine (10 penalty units maximum).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Directions given under subsection (2) do not affect the legal title to the property or any legal right to possession of the property.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP is not liable for or with respect to any direction given by the DPP under subsection (2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.12", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "157", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Chapter 8 contains general provisions that apply to all criminal proceedings.

heading: Filing hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Filing hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a filing hearing, the Magistrates' Court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: fix a date for a committal mention hearing;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: fix a period of time for service of a hand-up brief;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "101", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: make any order or give any direction that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Time limit for filing hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "102", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The date fixed for a filing hearing must be—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "102", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 7 days after the charge-sheet is filed, if the accused has been arrested and either remanded in custody or granted bail; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "102", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 28 days after the charge-sheet is filed, if a summons to answer to a charge is issued in respect of the accused.

heading: Compulsory examination
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Application for order
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to this section, an informant may apply for an order under section 104(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1) may only be made—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: after a charge-sheet has been filed against the accused in relation to the matter to which the proposed examination relates; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (3), before the committal hearing, if any, commences.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1) may be made after the committal mention hearing only if the Magistrates' Court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to allow the making of the application at that time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application under subsection (1), the informant must advise the Magistrates' Court of the following information—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the person sought to be examined has been asked by the prosecution to make a statement and has refused to do so; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the informant is aware of whether the person sought to be examined has obtained legal advice concerning the proposed examination; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the person sought to be examined is or has been a suspect with respect to the matter to which the proposed examination relates; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the person sought to be examined has been made aware of the application; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other information prescribed by the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1) may be made with or without notice to the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the person sought to be examined in an application under subsection (1) is or has been a suspect with respect to the matter to which the proposed examination relates, the informant must give reasonable notice of the application to the person, or a legal practitioner representing the person, whether or not—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge-sheet against the person has been filed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge against the person has been determined.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is not a party to an application under subsection (1); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "103", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may not address the court on the application.

heading: Order for compulsory examination hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the application of the informant, the Magistrates' Court may make an order requiring a person to attend before the court on a date fixed by the court for the purpose of being examined by or on behalf of the informant or producing a document or thing or both.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may make an order under subsection (1) if it is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "104", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may set aside an order under subsection (1) at any time, whether on its own motion or on the application of the informant or the person sought to be examined.

heading: Notice of compulsory examination order to be served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant must serve notice of an order made under section 104(1) on—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person to whom the order relates; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The notice must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be in the form prescribed by the rules of court; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 105(2)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(x).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "105", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 134, "rect": {"page": 134, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 379.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 418.1}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-19T06:38:54.021450+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be served personally on the person to whom the order relates in accordance with section 391.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 134(1) of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989 (contempt of court) applies to a person ordered to attend the Magistrates' Court under section 104(1) as if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person had been summoned as a witness and had been given or tendered any conduct money required to be given or tendered; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "105", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the order were a summons.

heading: Compulsory examination hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person ordered under section 104(1) to attend the Magistrates' Court for a compulsory examination hearing—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may be represented at the hearing by a legal practitioner; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may address the court personally or through the legal practitioner.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The evidence of a witness at a compulsory examination hearing must be—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 106(2)(a) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "106", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 135, "rect": {"page": 135, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 191.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 239.5}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-19T06:39:26.642652+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: sworn or affirmed and given by way of examination-in-chief; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: recorded in the same manner as evidence at a committal hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused may attend a compulsory examination hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a compulsory examination hearing, if the Magistrates' Court determines that there are exceptional circumstances, the accused may address the court personally or through a legal practitioner representing the accused but  may not cross-examine a witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "106", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section excludes or limits the operation of any other law as to the competence or compellability of a witness to give evidence.

heading: Pre-hearing disclosure of prosecution case
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Informant must serve hand-up brief
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (2), the informant must serve on the accused a hand-up brief that complies with section 110.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant is not required to serve a hand-up brief if he or she has served a plea brief under section 116 and the accused pleads guilty to the charge.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 107(3) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "107", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 136, "rect": {"page": 136, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 328.7, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 367.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "107", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At the same time as the hand-up brief is served, the informant must serve on the accused a copy of the criminal record of the accused or a statement that the accused has no previous convictions or infringement convictions.

heading: How hand-up brief must be served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "108", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A hand-up brief must be served at least 42 days before the committal mention hearing unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: file a copy of the disclosure certificate with the registrar within 7 days after service of the hand-up brief on the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the DPP is conducting the proceeding, forward a copy of the disclosure certificate to the DPP within 7 days after service of the hand-up brief on the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: serve a copy of the disclosure certificate on the accused at the same time as the hand-up brief is served on the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In completing a disclosure certificate, the relevant officer is not required to describe any information, document or thing, or the nature of the privilege, immunity, prohibition or restriction to which that information, document or thing is subject, in a way that would prejudice—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a claim of public interest immunity made to the Supreme Court in its inherent jurisdiction that has commenced or that the informant knows will be commenced; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an application for a non-disclosure order that has commenced or that the informant knows will be commenced.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section limits or otherwise affects—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the power of the court to hear and determine an application with respect to the disclosure of information, documents or things; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the power of the court to make any order or other decision that it has power to make with respect to the disclosure of information, documents or things; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the operation of a provision made by or under any other Act, including an Act of the Commonwealth, that prohibits or restricts, or that authorises a court or tribunal to prohibit or restrict, the disclosure of information for or in connection with any proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The relevant officer and informant must comply with subsections (1) and (2) unless the court otherwise orders.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, relevant officer means—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the informant; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the informant did not investigate the offence that is the subject of the proceeding, the law enforcement officer who prepared the hand-up brief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "110A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 416 as to the prosecution's general obligation of disclosure.

heading: Continuing obligation of disclosure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to any information, document or thing that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: comes into the informant's possession or comes to the informant's notice after the service of the hand-up brief; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would have been required to be listed, or a copy of which would have been required to be served, in the hand-up brief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: serve on the accused a copy of the document or list; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: file a copy with the registrar; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the DPP is conducting the committal proceeding, forward another copy to the DPP—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as soon as practicable after the information, document or thing comes into the informant's possession or comes to the informant's notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to a plea brief.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 111 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zb).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "111", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 145, "rect": {"page": 145, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 272.2, "x1": 515.1, "y1": 311.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "111", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 416 as to the prosecution's general obligation of disclosure.

heading: Rules with respect to statements
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A statement that the informant intends to tender in a committal proceeding must be—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the form of an affidavit; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: signed by the person making the statement and must contain an acknowledgment signed by that person in the presence of a person referred to in Schedule 3 that the statement is true and correct and is made in the belief that a person making a false statement in the circumstances is liable to the penalties of perjury; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in a form, and attested to in a manner, prescribed by the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person under the age of 18 years makes a statement that the informant intends to tender in a committal proceeding, the statement must include the person's age.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person who cannot read makes a statement that the informant intends to tender in a committal proceeding—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the statement must be read to the person before he or she signs it; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the acknowledgment must state that the statement was read to the person before he or she signed it.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 112 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 9(k).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "112", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 146, "rect": {"page": 146, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 264.4, "x1": 126.7, "y1": 303.5}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-19T09:32:52.596738+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "112", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 414 provides for acknowledgment of false statements.

heading: Rules with respect to recordings
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "113", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 113(1) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 11, 55/2014 s. 168(b), 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "113", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 146, "rect": {"page": 146, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 338.9, "x1": 125.7, "y1": 414.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "113", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A transcript of an audio or audiovisual recording of an examination under section 106 or of the evidence-in-chief of a witness under Division 5 of Part 8.2 or of an examination under Part 4 of the Major Crime (Investigative Powers) Act 2004 must be accompanied by an affidavit sworn or affirmed by the person who asked the questions, or made the recording, attesting to the accuracy of the recording.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "113", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person who acknowledges the contents of a recording referred to in subsection (1) that the person knows at the time to be false may be dealt with as if the contents of the recording had been evidence given in court.

heading: Disclosure of address or telephone number of witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant must not disclose the address or telephone number (including a private, business or official address or telephone number) of any person in any information, document or thing provided to the accused under this Part unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the informant believes that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the information, document or thing does not identify the address or telephone number as that of any particular person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the address or telephone number is relevant to the offence charged and disclosure is not likely to present a reasonably ascertainable risk to the welfare or physical safety of any person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court permits the disclosure in accordance with subsection (3) on application made by the informant or the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1), the informant may delete, or render illegible, an address or telephone number included in the information, document or thing before service on the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may grant an application made under subsection (1)(b) if the court is satisfied that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the address or telephone number is relevant to the offence charged; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: one of the following applies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: disclosure is not likely to present a reasonably ascertainable risk to the welfare or physical safety of any person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having regard to the matters referred to in subsection (4), the interests of justice outweigh any risk referred to in subparagraph (i).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (3)(b)(ii), the Magistrates' Court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right to privacy of the witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right of the accused to prepare properly for the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Compliance, or a failure to comply, with subsection (1) does not affect the admissibility of a statement.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "114", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 14 of the Victims' Charter Act 2006 as to victims' privacy.

heading: Inspection of exhibits
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused may inspect the exhibits at a time and place agreed between the accused and the informant.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 115 inserted by No. 42/2015 s. 17, amended by No. 47/2016 s. 37(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "115", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 148, "rect": {"page": 148, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 352.2, "x1": 126.7, "y1": 418.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "115", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 45(1)(g) and 122(2) provide for restricting inspection by an accused personally of evidence that is child abuse material.

heading: Informant may serve and file plea brief
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time before service of a hand-up brief, the informant may serve on the accused a plea brief that complies with section 117 if consent is given under subsection (2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A plea brief may only be served if the accused, or a legal practitioner representing the accused, gives written consent to the service of a plea brief to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the informant; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the DPP is conducting the committal proceeding, the DPP.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 116(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zc).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "116", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 148, "rect": {"page": 148, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 600.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 639.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A plea brief must be served on the accused in accordance with section 394 (ordinary service).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Within 7 days after service of the plea brief on the accused, the informant must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: file a copy of a plea brief with the registrar; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the DPP is conducting the committal proceeding, forward another copy to the DPP.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "116", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 142 provides for determination of a committal proceeding where a plea brief is used.

heading: Contents of plea brief
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "117", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "117", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A plea brief must contain—

text: See section 123(1) for certain proceedings in which the Magistrates' Court must not grant leave to cross-examine any witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "119", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If Part 4.6A requires the Magistrates' Court to commit the accused for trial in the Supreme Court, there is to be no committal hearing at which cross-examination could occur—see section 100(1A)(b).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "119", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Except as provided by section 125(1A), at a committal mention hearing, the Magistrates' Court may grant leave to cross-examine a witness on one or more issues. If the Magistrates' Court grants leave to cross-examine a witness, the court must identify each issue on which the witness may be cross-examined. See section 124A(b).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "119", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "120", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the parties have indicated in a case direction notice under section 118 that an adjournment of the committal mention hearing would assist them in determining how the matter should be dealt with, the Magistrates' Court may, without requiring the appearance of the informant or the accused, if satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adjourn the hearing for up to 14 days and fix another date for a committal mention hearing; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused has been granted bail in respect of the committal proceeding—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: excuse the accused from attending on the date on which the accused was bailed to attend; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: extend the bail of the accused to the date fixed under paragraph (a).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court adjourns a committal mention hearing under subsection (1), it must give to the prosecution and the accused written notice of the date to which the hearing is adjourned.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 121(3) amended by No. 28/2023 s. 67(1)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "121", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 156, "rect": {"page": 156, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 333.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 372.5}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-19T09:38:38.520916+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the extension of bail by the court in the absence of the accused and the bail guarantor; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the date, time and place at which the accused is bound to attend; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: bail guarantor
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "121", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "bail guarantor"}
text: has the same meaning as in the Bail Act 1977.

heading: Compliance with request to copy or inspect items or disclose previous convictions of witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (2), the informant must comply with any reasonable request referred to in section 119(e)(i) or (ii) for a copy of an item but, if the informant considers that it is not reasonable to copy the item owing to its size or nature, the informant must allow the accused to inspect it on or before the committal mention hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant may object to the production of an item requested under section 119(e)(i) or (ii) on any ground referred to in section 45 or 114.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 122(2) inserted by No. 42/2015 s. 18, amended by No. 47/2016 s. 37(7).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "122", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 157, "rect": {"page": 157, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 205.0, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 280.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 45(1)(g) provides for restricting inspection by an accused personally of evidence that is child abuse material.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The informant may object to the disclosure of the particulars of any previous conviction of any witness requested under section 119(e)(iii) if the previous conviction is, because of its character, irrelevant to the proceeding but the informant must advise the accused of the existence of any undisclosed previous convictions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 14 of the Victims' Charter Act 2006 as to victims' privacy.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: requires the informant to produce an item listed in the hand-up brief if its production is not requested under section 119(e)(i) or a witness summons is not issued in respect of it, unless the Magistrates' Court otherwise orders; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: prevents the Magistrates' Court or the informant proceeding, or proceeding further, with the committal hearing, irrespective of any statement included by the accused in the notice under section 119(f).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "122", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a committal mention hearing the Magistrates' Court may hear and determine any objection to disclosure of material: section 125(1)(e).

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 124(1) amended by No. 48/2018 s. 25(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "124", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 159, "rect": {"page": 159, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 274.5, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 313.6}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 124(1AA) inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 25(1), substituted by No. 5/2025 s. 27.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "124", "sub_path": ["(1AA)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 158, "rect": {"page": 158, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 581.5, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 648.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "124", "subsection": "1AA", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "124", "subsection": "1AA", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused requests that a committal mention hearing be held after the period referred to in subsection (1)(a) or (b) (as the case requires) and the Magistrates' Court is satisfied that in the interests of justice the request should be granted.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "126", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "statement"}
text: means a statement of a witness, a copy of which was served in the hand-up brief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A witness may be called to give evidence at a committal hearing if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court grants leave under section 124 for the cross-examination of the witness; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having regard to the interests of justice, the Magistrates' Court grants leave to the prosecution to call the witness to give oral evidence-in-chief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court grants leave under section 124 to cross-examine a witness, the evidence-in-chief of the witness must be confined to the witness identifying himself or herself (in a manner consistent with section 131) and attesting to the truthfulness of the statement or the contents of the recording, unless the Magistrates' Court gives leave under subsection (4) or (5).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If it is in the interests of justice, the Magistrates' Court may give leave for a witness referred to in subsection (3) to give oral evidence-in-chief supplementary to the statement or recording.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If exceptional circumstances exist, the Magistrates' Court may give leave for a witness referred to in subsection (3) to give the whole of his or her evidence-in-chief orally.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On application by a party, the Magistrates' Court may permit a statement or the transcript of a recording to be read aloud before the witness is asked to attest to its truthfulness or is cross-examined.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to section 124, a witness who gives evidence-in-chief may be cross-examined and re-examined.

Pt 2 item 18.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "130", "sub_path": ["(8)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 173, "rect": {"page": 173, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 341.2, "x1": 516.8, "y1": 389.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "130", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence given at a committal hearing must be recorded in accordance with Part VI of the Evidence (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1958.

heading: Disclosure of address or telephone number of witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A witness whose address or telephone number was not disclosed in material provided to the accused under Part 4.4 must not disclose that information to the Magistrates' Court unless the court permits the disclosure in accordance with subsection (2) on application by the informant or the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may only grant an application under subsection (1) if the court is satisfied that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the address or telephone number is relevant to the offence charged; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: one of the following applies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: disclosure is not likely to present a reasonably ascertainable risk to the welfare or physical safety of any person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having regard to the matters referred to in subsection (3), the interests of justice outweigh any risk referred to in subparagraph (i).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (2)(b)(ii), the Magistrates' Court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right to privacy of the witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "131", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right of the accused to prepare properly for the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "132", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 132(1) substituted by No. 55/2014 s. 110(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "132", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 174, "rect": {"page": 174, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 325.6, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 364.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "132", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "132A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Failure of witness to attend committal hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "134", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "134", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a witness who is required to attend a committal hearing does not attend, the Magistrates' Court may—

Pt 1 item 14.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "134", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 176, "rect": {"page": 176, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 244.6, "x1": 128.4, "y1": 292.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "134", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: cause a summons to be issued to compel the attendance of the witness; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "134", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Court may permit accused to be absent from committal hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Before or during a committal hearing, an accused may apply to the Magistrates' Court for permission to be absent from the committal hearing for a specified period.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On application made under subsection (1), the Magistrates' Court may permit an accused to be absent from the committal hearing for a period, and subject to any conditions, specified by the court if the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is satisfied that there are special circumstances in respect of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: considers that the committal hearing cannot be postponed without undue prejudice or inconvenience to the prosecution or any other accused or any witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court permits an accused to be absent from a committal hearing, the court may continue the committal hearing in the absence of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "135", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The power under section 330(3) to excuse the attendance of an accused does not apply to this section.

heading: Accused who absconds etc. during a committal hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "136", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
