text: is absent for any other reason without the permission of the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "136", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court may continue the committal hearing in the absence of the accused if the court considers that the committal hearing cannot be postponed without undue prejudice or inconvenience to the prosecution or any other accused or any witness.

heading: Accused (natural person) absent at close of prosecution case
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 137 amended by No. 5/2025 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "137", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 177, "rect": {"page": 177, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 584.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 623.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "137", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "137", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a committal hearing is continued in the absence of an accused who is a natural person; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "137", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused is not present when the evidence for the prosecution is concluded—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "137", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: postpone the committal hearing until the accused is present; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "137", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "137", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if any other accused is present, postpone the committal hearing in respect of the charge against the absent accused.

heading: Procedure on accused's attendance after absence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has been absent from a committal hearing; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was not represented by a legal practitioner during the absence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must direct that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the record of evidence be played or read in the presence of the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused be supplied with a transcript of the evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: then, on the accused's attendance, the Magistrates' Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "138", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may, on the application of the accused and subject to section 124, recall for further examination any witness who gave oral evidence during the accused's absence.

heading: Evidence in committal proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Admissibility of non-oral evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), on proof of their service on the accused in accordance with Part 4.4, the following are admissible as if their contents were a record of evidence given orally—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any statement the truthfulness of which has been attested to, other than a statement that is inadmissible under section 134(2);

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any exhibit or document referred to in a statement which is admissible;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any recording the truthfulness of the contents of which has been attested to, other than a recording that is inadmissible under section 134(2);

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other recording a transcript of which has been served in the hand-up brief, other than a recording that is inadmissible under section 134(2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Magistrates' Court may rule as inadmissible the whole or any part of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a statement; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any exhibit or document referred to in a statement; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the contents of a recording.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 139(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 14(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "139", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 179, "rect": {"page": 179, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 573.1, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 612.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "139", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A recording, a transcript of which has been served in the hand-up brief, is only admissible if it is proved that the accused and his or her legal practitioner were given a reasonable opportunity to listen to and, in the case of an audiovisual recording, view the recording.

heading: Procedure if accused makes admission of relevant fact or matter
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "140", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "140", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If under section 184 of the Evidence Act 2008 an accused makes, during a committal proceeding, an admission of any fact or matter that is relevant in the proceeding, the Magistrates' Court must cause the admission to be included in the record of the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.8", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "140", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An admission made by an accused during a committal proceeding may be used in evidence at the subsequent trial.

heading: Determination of committal proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Determination of committal proceeding where hand-up brief used
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 141 amended by Nos 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1), 48/2018 s. 27, substituted by No. 5/2025 s. 7.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "141", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 181, "rect": {"page": 181, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 206.4, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 291.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "141", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a hand-up brief is served and the accused has not elected to stand trial under section 143, the Magistrates' Court must commit the accused for trial in accordance with section 144—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "141", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if there is to be no cross-examination of witnesses, at the end of the committal mention hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "141", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if there is to be cross-examination of witnesses, at the end of the committal hearing.

heading: Determination of committal proceeding where plea brief used
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "142", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "142", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a plea brief is served, the Magistrates' Court, at the committal mention hearing, must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "142", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: ask how the accused pleads to the charge to which the committal proceeding relates; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 142(1)(b) amended by No. 5/2025 s. 8.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "142", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 181, "rect": {"page": 181, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 490.7, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 529.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "142", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused pleads guilty, commit the accused for trial in accordance with section 144.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "142", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused does not plead guilty to the charge to which the committal proceeding relates, the Magistrates' Court must direct the informant to prepare and serve a hand-up brief.

heading: Determination of committal proceeding where accused elects to stand trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Any time after the service on an accused of a hand-up brief, the accused may elect to stand trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An election is made by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: filing with the registrar a notice in the form prescribed by the rules of court and signed by the accused; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 143(2)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zd).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "143", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 182, "rect": {"page": 182, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 224.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 263.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: serving a copy of the notice on the informant in accordance with section 392.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: As soon as practicable after a notice is filed with the registrar under this section, the Magistrates' Court must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is in custody, direct that the accused be brought before the court; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is not in custody, direct that a summons to attend or warrant to arrest be issued.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "143", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the attendance of the accused before the Magistrates' Court, if the court considers that the accused understands the nature and consequence of the election, the court must commit the accused for trial in accordance with section 144.

heading: Procedure before and on committing accused for trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Before committing an accused for trial, the Magistrates' Court must, in the manner prescribed by the rules of court, if any—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: ask the accused whether the accused pleads guilty or not guilty to the charge; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: inform the accused that the sentencing court may take into account a plea of guilty and the stage in the proceeding at which the plea or an intention to plead guilty is indicated.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On committing an accused for trial, the Magistrates' Court must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused was not represented by a legal practitioner in the committal proceeding—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: explain to the accused the importance of obtaining legal representation for the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: advise that the accused has the right, if eligible, to legal aid under the Legal Aid Act 1978; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: warn the accused that, if the accused wishes to be legally aided, it is the accused's responsibility to make application to Victoria Legal Aid as soon as possible; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: explain to the accused, in a manner likely to be understood by the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the provisions of section 190 (alibi evidence), if relevant; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 144(2)(b)(ii) substituted by No. 68/2009 s. 15.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "144", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)", "(ii)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 183, "rect": {"page": 183, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 461.8, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 500.9}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-19T09:47:56.709006+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the provisions of sections 342, 344 and 346, if relevant; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other information required to be given by the rules of court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is a natural person, remand the accused in custody, or grant bail, until trial or a date before trial fixed by the court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 333 where the accused is undergoing a sentence of detention in a youth justice centre.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 144(2)(c) substituted as Notes by No. 26/2017 s. 22.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "144", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(c)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 183, "rect": {"page": 183, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 596.2, "x1": 517.3, "y1": 653.7}, "confidence": "low"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 13 of the Bail Act 1977 prevents the Magistrates' Court granting bail to a person committed for trial on a charge of treason.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a corporate accused, order the accused to appear, by a representative or a legal practitioner, on the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence or on any other day specified by the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "4", "part": "4.9", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "144", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: DPP or Crown Prosecutor may file an indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to the Public Prosecutions Act 1994, the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor in the name of the DPP may file an indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An indictment may be filed at any time, except where otherwise provided by or under this or any other Act.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 163 provides time limits for the filing of certain indictments.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An indictment must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be in writing; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be signed by the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor in the name of the DPP; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: comply with Schedule 1.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 253 abolishes the common law procedure of calling a grand jury.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "159", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 172 permits the DPP to nominate an address for service of documents.  That information may be included on an indictment.

heading: Choice of Supreme Court or County Court for filing an indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An indictment may be filed in—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Supreme Court; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the County Court, if all of the indictable offences alleged in the indictment are within the jurisdiction of that court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 36A of the County Court Act 1958 for the criminal jurisdiction of the County Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether to file an indictment in the Supreme Court or in the County Court, the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the complexity of the case; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the seriousness of the alleged offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any particular importance attaching to the case; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "160", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other consideration that the DPP or Crown Prosecutor considers relevant.

heading: Direct indictment commences criminal proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "161", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The filing of a direct indictment commences a criminal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "161", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in accordance with section 6; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "161", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by a direction under section 415 that a person be tried for perjury.

history_json: [{"raw": "Notes to s. 161 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zf).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "161", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 193, "rect": {"page": 193, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 365.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 413.4}, "confidence": "low"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "161", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of direct indictment in section 3. This includes an indictment filed after the Magistrates' Court declines to commit an accused for trial in respect of the offence charged in the indictment or a related offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "161", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal proceeding may also be commenced—

heading: Filing of any other indictment does not commence criminal proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "162", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The filing of an indictment other than a direct indictment does not commence a new criminal proceeding against the accused.

heading: Time limits for filing certain indictments
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is committed for trial in respect of an offence other than a sexual offence, the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor may file an indictment against the person—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 6 months after the date of committal; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the period referred to in paragraph (a) or any extension of that period is extended under section 247, within the extended period.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is committed for trial in respect of a sexual offence in which the complainant was a child or a person with a cognitive impairment when the criminal proceeding was commenced, the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor may file an indictment against the person—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 14 days after the date of committal; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the period referred to in paragraph (a) or any extension of that period is extended under section 247, within the extended period.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is committed for trial in respect of a sexual offence other than one referred to in subsection (2), the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor may file an indictment against the person—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at least 28 days before the day on which the trial is listed to commence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "163", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the period referred to in paragraph (a), or any extension or abridgment of that period, is extended or abridged under section 247, within the extended or abridged period.

heading: Filing of fresh indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: fresh indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "fresh indictment"}
text: means an indictment which includes a charge for the same offence as an offence charged in an indictment previously filed in court against that accused or a related offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in section 163 prevents the filing of a fresh indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The filing of a fresh indictment does not commence a new criminal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the filing of a fresh indictment against an accused, proceedings in relation to a charge for the same offence or a related offence in an indictment previously filed in court against that accused are discontinued.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "164", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of related offences in section 3.

heading: Order for amendment of indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "165", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "165", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court at any time may order that an indictment be amended in any manner that the court thinks necessary, unless the required amendment cannot be made without injustice to the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "165", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment is amended by order under this section, the indictment is to be treated as having been filed in the amended form for the purposes of the trial and all proceedings connected with the trial.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 165 inserted by No. 81/2011 s. 13.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "165", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 195, "rect": {"page": 195, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 470.9, "x1": 515.1, "y1": 510.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "165", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 327Q provides a limitation on amendments in the case of direct indictments under Chapter 7A.

heading: Errors etc. in indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "166", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "166", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An indictment is not invalid by reason only of a failure to comply with Schedule 1.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "166", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A charge on an indictment is not invalid by reason only of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "166", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: omitting to state the time at which the offence was committed unless time is an essential element of the offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "166", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: incorrectly stating the time at which the offence was committed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "166", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: stating the offence to have been committed on an impossible day or on a day that never happened.

heading: Supreme Court may order that accused be tried in County Court or Supreme Court
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an indictment against an accused is filed in the Supreme Court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the offence charged in the indictment may be tried by the County Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Supreme Court may order that the accused be tried at a sitting of the County Court specified in the order.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment against an accused is filed in the County Court, the Supreme Court may order that the accused be tried at a sitting of the Supreme Court specified in the order.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 167 inserted by No. 38/2022 s. 77.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "167", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 196, "rect": {"page": 196, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 434.2, "x1": 126.7, "y1": 473.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "167", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order is made under section 167(1) or (2), the Supreme Court may also order that a proceeding for a summary offence be transferred from the Supreme Court to the County Court under section 241A(1) or from the County Court to the Supreme Court under section 241A(2) (as the case requires).

heading: Court may transfer certain charges to Magistrates' Court or Children's Court
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168 (Heading) amended by No. 30/2010 s. 61(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 196, "rect": {"page": 196, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 515.2, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 563.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168(1) amended by No. 30/2010 s. 61(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 196, "rect": {"page": 196, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 568.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 607.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time except during trial, the Supreme Court or the County Court may order that a proceeding for a charge for an indictable offence that may be heard and determined summarily be transferred to the Magistrates' Court or the Children's Court (as the case requires) if—

text: the accused consents to the transfer; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168(1)(b) substituted by No. 30/2010 s. 61(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 197, "rect": {"page": 197, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 168(4)(b) amended by No. 30/2010 s. 61(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168", "sub_path": ["(4)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 197, "rect": {"page": 197, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 610.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 649.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that the charge is appropriate to be determined summarily, having regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of the Magistrates' Court, the matters in section 29(2); or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of the Children's Court, whether the Children's Court is required to hear and determine the charge summarily by section 356(3) of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 28 for indictable offences that may be heard and determined summarily.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168(2) amended by Nos 30/2010 s. 61(4), 43/2017 s. 26.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 197, "rect": {"page": 197, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 373.8, "x1": 514.2, "y1": 422.2}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-21T22:06:59.313544+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order is made under this section, the transferred charge must be heard and determined summarily.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order is made under this section, the transferring court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: order that the accused appear before the Magistrates' Court or the Children's Court (as the case requires) on a specified date; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is a natural person, remand the accused in custody, or grant bail, to appear before the Magistrates' Court or the Children's Court (as the case requires) on a specified date; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a corporate accused, order the accused to appear, by a representative or a legal practitioner, before the Magistrates' Court on a specified date.

heading: Charges returned to Children's Court
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A (Heading) substituted by No. 54/2025 s. 24(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 198, "rect": {"page": 198, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 218.8, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 267.1}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 168A inserted by No. 43/2017 s. 27.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 198, "rect": {"page": 198, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 270.7, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 309.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 168(2), the court may, under section 168(1), transfer a charge in respect of an accused who is a child to the Children's Court if—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A(1)(b) substituted by No. 54/2025 s. 24(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 198, "rect": {"page": 198, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 404.8, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 443.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the charge is one that the Children's Court has determined, under section 356(6), (7A) or (7C) of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005, not to hear and determine summarily; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the child or the prosecution requests that the charge be heard and determined summarily; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the sentencing options available to the Children's Court under the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005 are adequate to respond to the child's offending; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A(1)(e) amended by No. 54/2025 s. 24(4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(e)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 198, "rect": {"page": 198, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 602.2, "x1": 123.5, "y1": 641.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that any of the following applies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is in the interests of the victim or victims that the charge be heard and determined summarily;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused is particularly vulnerable because of cognitive impairment or mental illness;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is a substantial and compelling reason why the charge should be heard and determined summarily.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A(1)(a) amended by No. 16/2020 s. 18, repealed by No. 54/2025 s. 24(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 198, "rect": {"page": 198, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 325.6, "x1": 123.5, "y1": 392.3}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-21T22:07:16.433639+00:00"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A(2) substituted by No. 54/2025 s. 24(5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 199, "rect": {"page": 199, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 252.4, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 291.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether there is a substantial and compelling reason why the charge should be heard and determined summarily, the court must have regard to the intention of Parliament that the following charges should not normally be heard and determined summarily—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge for an offence referred to in paragraph (f) of the definition of Category A serious youth offence in section 3 committed by a child aged 16 years or over;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: These offences are terrorism and foreign incursion offences.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge for a designated offence (within the meaning of section 516 of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005) committed by a child aged 14 years;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a charge for an offence against section 79 of the Crimes Act 1958 (carjacking) committed by a child who was 14 years of age or over.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A(3) amended by No. 54/2025 s. 24(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 199, "rect": {"page": 199, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 557.4, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 596.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 168(2), the court may, under section 168(1), transfer a charge to the Children's Court if the charge is for an offence referred to in paragraph (b) or (c) of the definition of Category B serious youth offence in section 3 committed when the child was aged 16 years or over, after considering whether section 356(3) of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005 has the effect that the offence should not be heard and determined summarily.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 168A(3) inserted by No. 54/2025 s. 24(7).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 200, "rect": {"page": 200, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The offences referred to in paragraphs (b) and (c) of the definition of Category B serious youth offence in section 3 are rape and rape by compelling sexual penetration.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 168A(4) inserted by No. 54/2025 s. 24(8).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "168A", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 200, "rect": {"page": 200, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 215.5, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 254.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "168A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Place of hearing of criminal trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "169", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "169", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal trial in the Supreme Court or the County Court is to be held in the court sitting at the place that is nearest to the place where the offence is alleged to have been committed, unless an order is made under section 192.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "169", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal trial is not invalid only because it was conducted at a place other than the place referred to in subsection (1).

heading: Multiple charges or multiple accused on single indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "170", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "170", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment contains more than one charge, the charges must be heard together unless an order is made under section 193 or 195.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "170", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment names more than one accused, whether in the same charge or separate charges, the charge or charges against all accused must be tried together unless an order is made under section 193.

heading: Notifying accused of indictment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Copy indictment to be served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP must, as soon as practicable after an indictment is filed, serve on the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the indictment; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the DPP does not have notice that the accused is represented by a legal practitioner, a notice in the form prescribed by the rules of court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: advising that legal representation should be sought and that the accused has the right, if eligible, to legal aid under the Legal Aid Act 1978; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: providing details of how to contact Victoria Legal Aid.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 171(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zg).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "171", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 201, "rect": {"page": 201, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 411.1, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 450.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "171", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a direct indictment is filed, the copy indictment referred to in subsection (1)(a) must be served personally on the accused in accordance with section 391.

heading: DPP may nominate address etc. for service of documents
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "172", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "172", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP may nominate in writing a business address, email address or fax number for service on the DPP of documents in relation to a charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "172", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A nomination under subsection (1) may be included on an indictment or any other document served on the accused.

heading: Extra notice for corporate accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a corporate accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is to be served with a copy of an indictment under section 171(1); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has not been served with a notice in relation to that offence under section 148—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the date and time specified in the order under section 144(2)(d) at which the accused must appear, by a representative or a legal practitioner; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the DPP must serve with the copy indictment a notice stating—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that if the accused does not appear on the date and time specified in the order, the court may, in its absence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: proceed with the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "173", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if applicable, proceed to hear and determine a summary offence under Division 1 of Part 5.8.

heading: Compelling attendance when direct indictment filed
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the filing in court of a direct indictment against an accused, the DPP may apply to the court for the issue of a summons or a warrant to arrest in order to compel the attendance of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application under subsection (1), the court, if satisfied that the charge discloses an offence known to law, must issue—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summons requiring the accused to attend at the court on a specified date and at a specified time to answer to the indictment; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (3), a warrant to arrest.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 174(3) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "174", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 203, "rect": {"page": 203, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must not issue in the first instance a warrant to arrest unless satisfied by sworn or affirmed evidence, whether oral or by affidavit, that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is probable that the accused will not answer a summons; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has absconded, is likely to abscond or is avoiding service of a summons that has been issued; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a warrant is required or authorised by any other Act or for other good cause.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused fails to attend before the court on the date and at the time specified in the summons, the court, on the application of the DPP, may issue a warrant to arrest the accused.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 174 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zh).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "174", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 203, "rect": {"page": 203, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 394.6, "x1": 515.1, "y1": 433.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "174", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP must serve a summons issued under section 174 by personal service on the accused in accordance with section 391 at least 14 days before the date specified in the summons.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A summons served on the accused must be accompanied by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the indictment; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if applicable, a notice required by section 171(1); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a corporate accused, a notice stating that, if the accused does not appear in answer to the summons, the court may, in its absence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: proceed with the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "175", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if applicable, proceed to hear and determine a summary offence under Division 1 of Part 5.8.

heading: Warrant to be accompanied by indictment and notice
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "176", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On execution of a warrant issued under section 174, the warrant must be accompanied by a copy of the indictment and, if applicable, a notice required by section 171(1).

heading: Discontinuing a prosecution
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: DPP may discontinue a prosecution without adjudication
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP may discontinue a prosecution for an offence against an accused by—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 177(1)(a) amended by No. 11/2021 s. 46.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "177", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 205, "rect": {"page": 205, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 249.1, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 288.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: announcing the discontinuance in court (including by audio link or audio visual link); or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 177(1)(b) amended by No. 77/2013 s. 17.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "177", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 205, "rect": {"page": 205, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 296.5, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 335.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: filing in court written notice of the discontinuance, signed by the DPP.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A prosecution may be discontinued—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at any time except during trial;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether or not an indictment against the accused has been filed.
