path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment has not been filed against the accused, the written notice referred to in subsection (1)(b) must be filed in the court to which the accused has been committed for trial.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 177(4) amended by No. 77/2013 s. 17.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "177", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 205, "rect": {"page": 205, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 484.3, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 523.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a discontinuance of prosecution is announced in court, written notice of the discontinuance, signed by the DPP, must be filed in court as soon as practicable after the announcement.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP must serve a copy of a written notice of discontinuance that has been filed in court under subsection (1)(b) or (4) on—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is dead, on—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the legal practitioner who last represented the accused, if that legal practitioner can reasonably be identified; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the next of kin of the accused, if that person can reasonably be identified.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A discontinuance of prosecution does not amount to an acquittal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "177", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused may be indicted on a charge in respect of which an earlier prosecution has been discontinued.

heading: Release from custody on discontinuance of prosecution
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a prosecution for a charge against a person is discontinued under section 177; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the person is in custody in relation to that charge, irrespective of whether the person is in custody for any other reason—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the DPP must immediately notify the person who has legal custody of the person that the prosecution has been discontinued.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On notification being given under subsection (1), the person in custody is to be released, if the person is not in custody for any other reason.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "178", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See Part 1A of the Corrections Act 1986 and section 483 of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005 as to who has legal custody.

heading: Pre-trial procedure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Directions hearings
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Directions hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "179", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time except during trial, the court may conduct one or more directions hearings.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "179", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 210 sets out when a trial commences.

heading: Accused may be arraigned at a directions hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "180", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "180", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused may be arraigned at a directions hearing, if an indictment has been filed against the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "180", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 215 sets out how and when arraignment occurs.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "180", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Arraignment at a directions hearing does not commence a trial: see section 210.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "180", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (1), if the accused pleads not guilty to one or more charges in the indictment and indicates an intention to plead not guilty to one or more remaining charges, it is not necessary for those remaining charges to be read to the accused and the accused must be taken to have pleaded not guilty to those charges.

heading: Powers of court at directions hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a directions hearing, the court may make or vary any direction or order, or require a party to do anything that the court considers necessary, for the fair and efficient conduct of the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting subsection (1), the court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the accused to advise whether the accused is legally represented and has funding for continued legal representation up to and including the trial;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 181(2)(b) amended by No. 32/2024 s. 820(1)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "181", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 208, "rect": {"page": 208, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 238.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 277.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: without being limited by section 200, require the parties to notify the court of any pre-trial issues that the parties intend to raise or any orders under section 199(1) or 206A that the parties intend to seek;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 181(2)(c) amended by No. 32/2024 s. 820(1)(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "181", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 208, "rect": {"page": 208, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 313.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 352.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: without being limited by section 200, set a timetable for the hearing of pre-trial issues or applications for orders under Division 3, 4 or 5;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 181(2)(d) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 19, substituted by No. 48/2012 s. 13, amended by Nos 5/2025 s. 16, 1/2026 s. 71.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "181", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(d)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 208, "rect": {"page": 208, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 374.8, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 478.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a trial for a sexual offence, a family violence offence or an offence against section 21A(1) of the Crimes Act 1958 (stalking) in which the complainant was a child or a person with a cognitive impairment when the criminal proceeding was commenced—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the prosecutor to advise as to the availability of the complainant, and the accused to advise as to his or her own availability for the special hearing to be held under Division 6 of Part 8.2; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give a direction under section 370(1A) that the special hearing is to be held before the trial or during the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the special hearing is to be held during the trial, specify the date on which the special hearing is to commence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 5 as to the commencement of a criminal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the parties to provide an estimate of the length of the trial;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: require the parties to advise as to the estimated number and the availability of witnesses (other than the accused) and any relevant requirements of witnesses and interpreters;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: order a party to make, file in court or serve (as the case requires) any written or oral material required by the court for the purposes of the proceeding;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: order the prosecution to file in court and serve on the accused a copy of any material on which the prosecution intends to rely at the trial;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "i", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: determine any objection relating to the disclosure of information or material by the prosecution;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "j", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: allow a party to amend a document that has been prepared by or on behalf of that party for the purposes of the proceeding;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "k", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: determine an application for a sentence indication.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a directions hearing, the court may make any order or other decision that can be made or decided before trial by or under this or any other Act.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 181(3) amended by No. 32/2024 s. 820(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "181", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 209, "rect": {"page": 209, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 624.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 673.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 199(1) and 206A indicate the issues that may be decided before trial under this Act.

heading: Course of conduct charge
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 181A inserted by No. 74/2014 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "181A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 210, "rect": {"page": 210, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section course of conduct charge has the same meaning as in clause 4A of Schedule 1.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if the charge on an indictment is a course of conduct charge and the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would plead guilty to the charge if it related only to a specified period falling within the period to which the charge relates; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would plead not guilty to the charge insofar as it relates to any other period within the period to which the charge relates.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused must, at a directions hearing or otherwise, advise the court of the matters referred to in subsection (2) as soon as possible after deciding how to plead to the charge on the indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused advises the court in accordance with subsection (3) and the court is satisfied that, having regard to that advice, it is not appropriate for the accused to be arraigned, the accused must not be arraigned at a directions hearing pending the filing of a fresh indictment or the making of a decision to proceed with the indictment as already filed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a fresh indictment is filed against the accused containing a charge relating only to the specified period referred to in subsection (2)(a) and the accused does not plead guilty to the charge on that indictment, a further fresh indictment may be filed containing the original charge or an amended version of that charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "181A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused may be arraigned on that further fresh indictment unless the court considers that it is not in the interests of justice to do so.

heading: Pre-trial disclosure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Summary of prosecution opening and notice of pre-trial admissions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Unless the court otherwise directs, at least 28 days before the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence, the DPP must serve on the accused and file in court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summary of the prosecution opening; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a notice of pre-trial admissions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The summary of the prosecution opening must outline—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the manner in which the prosecution will put the case against the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the acts, facts, matters and circumstances being relied on to support a finding of guilt.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The notice of pre-trial admissions must identify the statements of the witnesses whose evidence, in the opinion of the DPP, ought to be admitted as evidence without further proof, including evidence that is directed solely to formal matters including—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: continuity; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person's age; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: proving the accuracy of a plan, or that photographs were taken in a certain manner or at a certain time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "182", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused has not received, under section 147, a copy of a statement identified in a notice of pre-trial admissions, the notice must contain a copy of the statement.

heading: Response of accused to summary of prosecution opening and notice of pre-trial admissions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 183(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zj).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "183", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 212, "rect": {"page": 212, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 191.2, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After being served with a copy of the documents referred to in section 182, the accused must serve on the prosecution in accordance with section 392 and file in court, at least 14 days before the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the response of the accused to the summary of the prosecution opening; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the response of the accused to the notice of pre-trial admissions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The response of the accused to the summary of the prosecution opening must identify the acts, facts, matters and circumstances with which issue is taken and the basis on which issue is taken.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The response of the accused to the notice of pre-trial admissions must indicate what evidence, as set out in the notice of pre-trial admissions, is agreed to be admitted as evidence without further proof and what evidence is in issue and, if issue is taken, the basis on which issue is taken.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsections (2) and (3), the accused is not required to state—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the identity of any witness (other than an expert witness) to be called by the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "183", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the accused will give evidence.

heading: Intention to depart at trial from document filed and served
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "184", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a party intends to depart substantially at trial from a matter set out in a document served and filed by that party under this Division, the party—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "184", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must so inform the court and the other party in advance of the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "184", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court so orders, must inform the court and the other party of the details of the proposed departure.

heading: Continuing obligation of disclosure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to any information, document or thing that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: comes into the possession of the prosecution after an accused is committed for trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is in the possession of the prosecution when, or comes into the possession of the prosecution after, a direct indictment is filed against an accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: and would have been required to be listed, or a copy of which would have been required to be served, in the hand-up brief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 110 for the contents of a hand-up brief.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 185(2) amended by No. 42/2015 s. 20.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "185", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 213, "rect": {"page": 213, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 550.1, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 589.2}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T07:46:35.195495+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (4) and section 185A, the prosecution must serve on the accused a copy of the document or list as soon as practicable after—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the information, document or thing comes into the possession of the prosecution; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the direct indictment is filed against the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as the case requires.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the information, document or thing cannot reasonably be copied, the prosecution must advise the accused of the existence of the information, document or thing and make it available for inspection at a time and place agreed between the accused and the prosecution.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The prosecution need not provide any information, document or thing under this section if it has already been provided to the accused by the prosecution.

history_json: [{"raw": "Notes to s. 185 amended by No. 68/2009 ss 49(i), 51(zk).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "185", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 214, "rect": {"page": 214, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 307.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 365.1}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T07:46:23.343784+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 188 requires the prosecution to serve a notice if additional evidence is to be given at trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 416 as to the prosecution's general obligation of disclosure.

heading: Disclosure of evidence that is child abuse material
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 185A (Heading) amended by No. 47/2016 s. 37(8).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "185A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 214, "rect": {"page": 214, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 383.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 431.4}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 185A inserted by No. 42/2015 s. 21.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "185A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 214, "rect": {"page": 214, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 435.0, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 474.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 185A(1) amended by No. 47/2016 s. 37(9).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "185A", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 214, "rect": {"page": 214, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 482.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 521.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The prosecution need not provide, or make available for inspection, any information, document or thing that is required by section 185 to be provided or made available for inspection if the prosecutor believes that doing so will result in the disclosure of child abuse material to the accused personally.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused may apply to the court for an order requiring the prosecution to provide, or make available for inspection, any information, document or thing not provided or made available for inspection under subsection (1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court, having regard to whether the accused is legally represented, may order, on any conditions specified by it, that the information, document or thing be provided to or made available for inspection by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused's legal practitioner (but not the accused personally); or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "185A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused personally.

heading: Disclosure of address or telephone number of witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The prosecution must not disclose the address or telephone number (including a private, business or official address or telephone number) of any person in any information, document or thing provided to the accused under this Division unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the prosecutor believes that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the information, document or thing does not identify the address or telephone number as that of any particular person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the address or telephone number is relevant to the offence charged and disclosure is not likely to present a reasonably ascertainable risk to the welfare or physical safety of any person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court permits the disclosure in accordance with subsection (3) on application made by the prosecutor or the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1), the prosecution may delete, or render illegible, an address or telephone number included in the information, document or thing before service on the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may grant an application made under subsection (1)(b) if the court is satisfied that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the address or telephone number is relevant to the offence charged; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: one of the following applies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: disclosure is not likely to present a reasonably ascertainable risk to the welfare or physical safety of any person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: having regard to the matters referred to in subsection (4), the interests of justice outweigh any risk referred to in subparagraph (i).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (3)(b)(ii), the court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right to privacy of the witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right of the accused to prepare properly for the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "186", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 14 of the Victims' Charter Act 2006 as to victims' privacy.

heading: Previous convictions of witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "187", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "187", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused may request the prosecutor to provide particulars of previous convictions of any witness who the prosecution intends to call at the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "187", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A request under subsection (1) does not require the prosecutor to give to the accused particulars of any previous conviction of any witness if the previous conviction is, because of its character, irrelevant to the proceeding but the prosecutor must advise the accused of the existence of any undisclosed previous convictions.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "187", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a directions hearing the court may hear and determine any objection to disclosure of any information, document or thing: section 181(2)(i).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "187", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 14 of the Victims' Charter Act 2006 as to victims' privacy.

heading: Prosecution notice of additional evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: additional evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "additional evidence"}
text: means any evidence that is not included in the depositions in the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the DPP intends to call a witness at trial to give additional evidence, the DPP must serve on the accused and file in court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a notice of intention to call additional evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a copy of the statement of the proposed witness containing the additional evidence or an outline of the additional evidence that the witness is expected to give.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of depositions in section 3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "188", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 185 (Continuing obligation of disclosure) requires the prosecution to serve a copy of a document as soon as practicable after the document comes into the possession of the prosecution.

heading: Expert evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 189(1) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zl).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "189", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 217, "rect": {"page": 217, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 580.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 619.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to call a person as an expert witness at the trial, the accused must serve on the prosecution in accordance with section 392 and file in court a copy of the statement of the expert witness in accordance with subsection (2)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at least 14 days before the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the statement is not then in existence, as soon as possible after it comes into existence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The statement must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: contain the name and business address of the witness;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: describe the qualifications of the witness to give evidence as an expert;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: set out the substance of the evidence it is proposed to adduce from the witness as an expert, including the opinion of the witness and the acts, facts, matters and circumstances on which the opinion is formed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "189", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 177 of the Evidence Act 2008 provides for certificates of expert evidence.

heading: Alibi evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused must not, without leave of the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give evidence personally; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: adduce evidence from another witness—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in support of an alibi unless the accused has given notice of alibi within the period referred to in subsection (2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of alibi must be given by serving the notice on the DPP within 14 days after—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the day on which the accused was committed for trial on the charge to which the alibi relates; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if paragraph (a) does not apply, the day on which the accused received a copy of the indictment.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 190(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zm).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "190", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 219, "rect": {"page": 219, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of alibi must be served in accordance with section 392.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of alibi must contain—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: particulars as to time and place of the alibi; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the name and last known address of any witness to the alibi; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the name and address of a witness are not known, any information which might be of material assistance in finding the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the name and address of a witness are not included in a notice of alibi, the accused must not call that person to give evidence in support of the alibi unless the court is satisfied that the accused took reasonable steps to ensure that the name and address would be ascertained.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is notified by the DPP that a witness named or referred to in a notice of alibi has not been traced, the accused must give written notice to the DPP, without delay, of any further information which might be of material assistance in finding the witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must not refuse leave under subsection (1) if it appears to the court that the accused was not informed of the requirements of this section.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an accused gives notice of alibi under this section; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the DPP requests an adjournment—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "190", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court must grant an adjournment for a period that appears to the court to be necessary to enable investigation of the alibi unless it appears that to do so would prejudice the proper presentation of the case of the accused.

heading: Offence to communicate with alibi witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person (other than a person referred to in subsection (2)) has been named or referred to as a proposed witness in a notice of alibi given under section 190—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person acting for the prosecution; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 191(1)(b) amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "191", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 220, "rect": {"page": 220, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 292.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 340.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a police officer—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the legal practitioner representing the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must not communicate with that person directly or indirectly with respect to the charge or any related matter before the conclusion of the proceeding, including any new trial or rehearing, without the consent and presence during the communication of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if not legally represented, the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Penalty: Level 8 imprisonment (1 year maximum)

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "191", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a person who the accused has been notified may be called as a witness for the prosecution at the trial.

heading: Orders
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Power to change place of trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "192", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court considers that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "192", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a fair trial in a criminal proceeding cannot otherwise be had; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "192", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for any other reason it is appropriate to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "192", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may order that the trial be held at any other place that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Order for separate trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment contains more than one charge, the court may order that any one or more of the charges be tried separately.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an indictment names more than one accused, the court may order that charges against a specified accused be tried separately.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may make an order under subsection (1) or (2) if the court considers that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the case of an accused may be prejudiced because the accused is charged with more than one offence in the same indictment; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a trial with the co-accused would prejudice the fair trial of the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for any other reason it is appropriate to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may make an order under subsection (1) or (2) or under section 195 before trial or during a trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court makes an order under subsection (1) or (2) or under section 195, the prosecutor may elect which charge is to be tried first.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order under subsection (1) or (2) or under section 195 is made after a jury is empanelled, the court may order that the jury be discharged from giving a verdict on the indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The procedure on the separate trial of a charge is the same in all respects as if the charge had been set out in a separate indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "193", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court makes an order for a separate trial under subsection (1) or (2) or under section 195, the court may make any order for or in relation to the bail of the accused that the court considers appropriate.

heading: Order for separate trial—sexual offences
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "194", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "194", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: sexual offence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "194", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "sexual offence"}
text: includes an offence to which clause 1 of Schedule 1 to the Sentencing Act 1991 applies.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "194", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 193 and any rule of law to the contrary (other than the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities), if in accordance with this Act 2 or more charges for sexual offences are joined in the same indictment, it is presumed that those charges are to be tried together.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "194", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The presumption created by subsection (2) is not rebutted merely because evidence on one charge is inadmissible on another charge.

heading: Order for separate trial—conspiracy
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "195", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 193, if an indictment contains a charge of conspiracy to commit an offence and another charge alleging the commission of that offence, the court must order that the charge of conspiracy be tried separately from the other charge, unless the court considers that it would be in the interests of justice to try those charges together.

heading: Other powers of court not affected
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "196", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Any power of the court under section 165, 193 or 195 is in addition to any other power of the court for the same or similar purposes.

heading: Order for legal representation for accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: private law practice
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "private law practice"}
text: has the same meaning as in the Legal Aid Act 1978;

heading: private legal practitioner
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "private legal practitioner"}
text: has the same meaning as in the Legal Aid Act 1978.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (3) and despite any rule of law to the contrary (other than the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities), the fact that an accused has been refused legal assistance in respect of a trial is not a ground for an adjournment or stay of the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court is satisfied at any time that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it will be unable to ensure that the accused will receive a fair trial unless the accused is legally represented in the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused is in need of legal representation because the accused is unable to afford the full cost of obtaining from a private law practice or private legal practitioner legal representation in the trial—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may order Victoria Legal Aid to provide legal representation to the accused, on any conditions specified by the court, and may adjourn the trial until that legal representation has been provided.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite anything in the Legal Aid Act 1978, Victoria Legal Aid must provide legal representation in accordance with an order under subsection (3).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite anything to the contrary in subsection (3)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court is satisfied that, in relation to the trial, the accused has engaged in vexatious or unreasonable conduct that has contributed to the accused's inability to afford the full cost of obtaining from a private law practice or private legal practitioner legal representation in the trial, the court may refuse to make an order under subsection (3);

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the legal burden of proof for the purposes of subsection (3)(b) that the accused is unable to afford the full cost of obtaining legal representation rests on the accused;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for the purposes of proving under subsection (3)(b) that the accused is unable to afford the full cost of obtaining legal representation, regard must be had to property—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that is subject to the effective control of the accused (whether or not the accused has an interest in it); or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in which the accused has an interest—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as determined in accordance with section 9 or 10 of the Confiscation Act 1997;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the conditions that may be specified by the court under subsection (3) do not include conditions relating to the identity, number or remuneration of persons representing the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A court must give Victoria Legal Aid an opportunity to appear and be heard before an order is made under subsection (3).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "197", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite anything to the contrary in this or any other Act, Victoria Legal Aid may appeal to the Court of Appeal, if the Court of Appeal gives leave to do so, from an order under subsection (3) made by the Trial Division of the Supreme Court constituted by a Judge.
