path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the purpose of the proposed questioning.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must not make the order sought in the application unless the court is satisfied that it is necessary to do so in order to avoid a serious risk that the trial would be unfair.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether it is necessary to make the order sought in the application in order to avoid a serious risk that the trial would be unfair, the court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the purposes of a committal proceeding as set out in section 97; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the limitations that apply in relation to cross-examination of a witness at a committal hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court makes the order sought in the application, the prosecution may re-examine a witness who is cross-examined in accordance with the order.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: before trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: during trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: During trial—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an application for an order under this section must be heard in the absence of the jury; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198B", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any cross-examination or re-examination in accordance with an order under this section, must be conducted in the absence of the jury.

heading: Abolition of Basha procedure
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 198C inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 31.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "198C", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 229, "rect": {"page": 229, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 317.8, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 356.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The common law procedure of an accused cross-examining a witness to enable the accused to adequately prepare and present a defence is abolished.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "3A", "subdivision": null, "section": "198C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This provision abolishes the procedure of holding a hearing of the kind attributed to R v Basha (1989) 39 A Crim R 337.

heading: Procedure for pre-trial orders and other decisions
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Court may make orders and other decisions before trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time before trial, the court may hear and decide any issue with respect to the trial that the court considers appropriate, including—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an issue of law or procedure that arises or is anticipated to arise in the trial, including an issue as to admissibility of evidence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an issue of fact, or mixed law and fact, that may be determined lawfully by a judge alone without a jury, including an issue as to admissibility of evidence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an application for an order that may be made in relation to the trial under this or any other Act or at common law, including an application to quash a charge in the indictment;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other issue with respect to the trial.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 199(1) inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 821.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "199", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 230, "rect": {"page": 230, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 252.4, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 300.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For a pre-trial determination of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted, see Division 5.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) applies despite sections 181, 183, 184 and 200.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An order or other decision made at a directions hearing or other pre-trial hearing has the same effect as if it had been made after the commencement of the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section limits the power of the court to make any order or other decision that it has power to make otherwise than under subsection (1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "199", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 192A of the Evidence Act 2008 provides for advance rulings in relation to evidence proposed to be adduced in a proceeding.

heading: Disclosure of pre-trial issues
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a party intends to raise an issue referred to in section 199(1)(a), (b), (c) or (d), whether before or during trial, the party must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: first, notify the other party of the issue or the order sought, in order to ascertain whether the issue will be in dispute or the order will be opposed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: secondly, notify the court of the issue or the order sought.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Notification under subsection (1)(b) must include—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: confirmation that the other party has been notified of the issue or the order sought; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: information, if available, as to whether the issue is in dispute or the order is opposed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Notification under subsection (1) must occur—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as soon as possible after the party becomes aware of the issue and at least 14 days before the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "200", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the party is not aware of the issue within the period referred to in paragraph (a), as soon as possible after the party becomes aware of it.

heading: Court may decide pre-trial issue without a hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 201(1) substituted by No. 11/2021 s. 45(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "201", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 231, "rect": {"page": 231, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 420.4, "x1": 517.7, "y1": 459.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if the court is notified of an issue under section 200(1) at least 14 days before the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 201(1A) inserted by No. 11/2021 s. 45(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "201", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 231, "rect": {"page": 231, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 481.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 520.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may decide the issue without an oral hearing and entirely on the basis of written submissions and without the appearance of the parties—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether or not the parties consent to the court doing so.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 201(1B) inserted by No. 11/2021 s. 45(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "201", "sub_path": ["(1B)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 231, "rect": {"page": 231, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 610.0, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 649.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1B", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1A), in deciding whether it is in the interests of justice to decide the issue without an oral hearing, the court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1B", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right of an accused to a fair hearing; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1B", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of the issue; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1B", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the accused or the offender (as the case requires) has had the opportunity to obtain legal advice; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "1B", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the parties consent to the court doing so.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 201(2) amended by No. 11/2021 s. 45(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "201", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 232, "rect": {"page": 232, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 258.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 297.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court decides to decide the issue on the basis of written submissions, at least 10 days before the day on which the trial of the accused is listed to commence, the party who raised the issue must file in court and serve on all other parties a copy of that party's submission.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Within 5 days after a party is served with a copy of a submission under subsection (2), that party must file in court and serve on all other parties a copy of a written submission in reply.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Within 3 days after a party is served with a written submission in reply under subsection (3), that party must file in court and serve on all other parties a copy of a written submission in response to the reply.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 201(5) repealed by No. 11/2021 s. 45(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "201", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 232, "rect": {"page": 232, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 483.4, "x1": 120.6, "y1": 522.5}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T07:53:31.483972+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "201", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Hearing of application for exclusion of evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "202", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the hearing of an application by the accused for the exclusion of evidence, the court may hear evidence called on behalf of the accused before it hears evidence called on behalf of the prosecution.

heading: Judge at pre-trial hearing need not be trial judge
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "203", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The judge who constitutes the court at a directions hearing or other pre-trial hearing held in connection with the trial of an accused need not be the trial judge on the trial of the accused.

heading: Pre-trial orders and other decisions generally binding on trial judge
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 204 amended by No. 32/2024 s. 822 (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "204", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 233, "rect": {"page": 233, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "204", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "204", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An order or other decision made at a directions hearing or other pre-trial hearing by a judge who is not the trial judge is binding on the trial judge unless the trial judge considers that it would not be in the interests of justice for the order or other decision to be binding.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 204(2) inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 822.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "204", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 233, "rect": {"page": 233, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 280.0, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 319.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "204", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to a pre-trial determination of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "204", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 206E.

heading: Pre-trial orders and other decisions may be applied in new trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "205", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "205", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a new trial is held, the court may treat any order or other decision made at a directions hearing or other pre-trial hearing held in connection with the earlier trial as if it had been made at a directions hearing or other pre-trial hearing held in connection with the new trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "205", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (1), the court need not treat an order or other decision in the manner set out in subsection (1) if the court considers that to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "205", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would be inconsistent with any order or decision made or direction given on an appeal; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "205", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: would otherwise not be in the interests of justice.

heading: Procedure if prosecution proposes not to lead evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "206", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "206", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if, before the trial of an accused commences, the accused is arraigned and pleads not guilty to a charge in respect of which the prosecution proposes not to lead evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "206", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The prosecution must inform the court that the prosecution proposes not to lead evidence on the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "206", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must direct that an entry of not guilty be made on the record in respect of the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "206", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An entry of not guilty under subsection (3) has the same effect as if it were the verdict of a jury on the trial of the accused on that charge.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 206A inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 823.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "206A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 234, "rect": {"page": 234, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 498.1, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 537.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At any time before trial of an accused for an offence allegedly committed at 12 or 13 years of age, the court may order that the issue of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted be determined by a judge alone, without a jury, if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the offence is an indictable offence under an Act; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the charge for the offence will not be heard and determined summarily; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the accused has obtained legal advice on the effect of the issue being determined by a judge alone, without a jury, before the trial of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that it is in the interests of justice to determine the issue before the trial of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may make an order under subsection (1) on the application of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to raise the issue of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted before trial, the accused must give notice to the court and the prosecution in accordance with section 200.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether to make an order under subsection (1), the court is to have regard to the submissions, if any, of the prosecution and the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (1) applies despite sections 181, 183 and 184.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206A", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: To avoid doubt, this section does not limit the application of section 199(1) in relation to any other issue that the court considers appropriate to hear and decide before a trial.

heading: Issue to be determined expeditiously
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 206B inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 823.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "206B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 235, "rect": {"page": 235, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 592.0, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 631.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: A pre-trial determination of the issue of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted must be conducted at the earliest possible opportunity before the arraignment of a person accused of committing an offence at 12 or 13 years of age.

heading: Conduct of pre-trial hearing about presumption against criminal responsibility
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 206C inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 823.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "206C", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 236, "rect": {"page": 236, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the application of the accused, the court may excuse the accused from attending the hearing if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to conduct the hearing without the attendance of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (2), in determining whether it is in the interests of justice, the court is to have regard to—

text: the right of an accused to a fair hearing; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the prosecution consents to the determination of the issue without the attendance of the accused.

heading: Court to be constituted by the same judge who made pre-trial determination
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 206D inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 823.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "206D", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 236, "rect": {"page": 236, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 542.8, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 581.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206D", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 203, as far as practicable, in the trial of a person who is accused of committing an offence at 12 or 13 years of age, the court is to be constituted by the same judge who constitutes the court in the pre-trial hearing of the issue of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted.

heading: Determination at pre-trial hearing as to whether presumption is rebutted
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 206E inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 823.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "206E", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 237, "rect": {"page": 237, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206E", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At a pre-trial hearing of the issue of whether the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted in respect of a charge for an offence, the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.5", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "206E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: A second or subsequent sentence indication may be given if there has been a change in circumstances since the previous sentence indication that is likely to materially affect the sentence indication previously given.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "208", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may refuse to give a sentence indication under section 207.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 208(5) inserted by No. 49/2012 s. 5.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "208", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 240, "rect": {"page": 240, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 327.4, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 366.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "208", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting subsection (4), the court may refuse to give a sentence indication under section 207 if the court considers there is insufficient information before it of the impact of the offence on any victim of the offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "208", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Under section 5(2)(daa) of the Sentencing Act 1991, in sentencing an offender a court must have regard to the impact of the offence on any victim of the offence.

heading: Effect of sentence indication
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 209(2) repealed by No. 1/2022 s. 113(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "209", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 240, "rect": {"page": 240, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 642.1, "x1": 120.6, "y1": 681.3}, "confidence": "low"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 209(1) substituted by No. 1/2022 s. 113(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "209", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 240, "rect": {"page": 240, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 480.1, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 519.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court gives a sentence indication under section 207; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused pleads guilty to any charge to which the sentence indication relates at the first available opportunity—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court, when sentencing the accused for the offence, must not impose a more severe sentence than the sentence type or maximum total effective sentence indicated.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A sentence indication does not bind the court on any hearing before the court constituted by a different judge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A decision to give or not to give a sentence indication is final and conclusive.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for a sentence indication and the determination of the application are not admissible in evidence against the accused in any proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not affect any right to appeal against sentence.

heading: Review of amendments—Justice Legislation Amendment (Criminal Procedure Disclosure and Other Matters) Act 2022
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 209A inserted by No. 1/2022 s. 114.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "209A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 241, "rect": {"page": 241, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 333.4, "x1": 507.2, "y1": 372.5}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Attorney-General must review the operation of the amendments made to Part 5.6 and section 9B of the Victims' Charter Act 2006 by the Justice Legislation Amendment (Criminal Procedure Disclosure and Other Matters) Act 2022 to determine—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: their effectiveness in reducing delay in the courts; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: their impact on victims; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the availability of information before the courts of the impact of an offence on any victim of the offence at the time that the court is considering an application for a sentence indication.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.6", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "209A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A review under subsection (1) must be conducted not later than 2 years after the amendments are made to Part 5.6 by the Justice Legislation Amendment (Criminal Procedure Disclosure and Other Matters) Act 2022.

heading: Trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Preliminary
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: When trial commences
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "210", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "210", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A trial commences when the accused pleads not guilty on arraignment in the presence of the jury panel in accordance with section 217.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "210", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a jury panel is split into 2 or more parts under section 30(5) of the Juries Act 2000, the trial commences when the accused pleads not guilty on arraignment in the presence of the first part of the jury panel that is present in court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "210", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 215 sets out how and when arraignment occurs.

heading: Time limit for commencing trial for offences other than sexual offences
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "211", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial of a person for an offence (other than a sexual offence) must commence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "211", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 12 months after the day on which the person is committed for trial in respect of the offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "211", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if no committal proceeding in respect of the offence is held, within 12 months after the day on which the indictment against the person is filed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "211", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if a new trial is ordered by the Court of Appeal, within 6 months after the day on which the order is made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "211", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the period referred to in paragraph (a), (b) or (c) or any extension of that period is extended under section 247, within the extended period.

heading: Time limits for commencing trials for sexual offences
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "212", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial of a person for a sexual offence must commence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "212", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: within 3 months after the day on which the person is committed for trial in respect of the offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "212", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if no committal proceeding in respect of the offence is held, within 3 months after the day on which the indictment against the person is filed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "212", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if a new trial is ordered by the Court of Appeal, within 3 months after the day on which the order is made; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 212(d) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(j).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "212", "sub_path": ["(d)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 243, "rect": {"page": 243, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 380.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 419.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "212", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the period referred to in paragraph (a), (b) or (c) or any extension of that period is extended under section 247, within the extended period.

heading: Powers of trial judge not affected
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "213", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "213", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to section 204, a trial judge may make any order or other decision during trial that could have been made under Division 3 or 4 of Part 5.5.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "213", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this Act removes or limits any powers of a trial judge that existed immediately before the commencement of this Act.

heading: Non-appearance of corporate accused at trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "214", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "214", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a corporate accused does not appear on the date and at the time specified in an order under section 144(2)(d), the court, may, in its absence, proceed with the trial and, if applicable, proceed to hear and determine a summary offence under Division 1 of Part 5.8 if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "214", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that a notice under section 148 or 173 has been served on the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "214", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that it is appropriate to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "214", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court conducts a trial in the absence of a corporate accused, the court may dispense with or vary any requirement imposed by or under this Part.

heading: Arraignment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Arraignment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "215", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "215", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused is arraigned when the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "215", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: asks the accused whether the accused is the person named on the indictment; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "215", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: reads out each charge on the indictment and asks the accused whether the accused pleads guilty or not guilty to the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "215", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused may be arraigned or re-arraigned at any time.

heading: Written pleas of guilty may be accepted
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused pleads guilty to one or more charges in the indictment and indicates an intention to plead guilty to one or more remaining charges—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is not necessary for those remaining charges to be read to the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may accept pleas of guilty to the remaining charges in the indictment by written notice signed by the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A court must not accept pleas of guilty under subsection (1)(b) unless—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the prosecution consents; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that it is appropriate to do so, having regard to the number of charges in the indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "216", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A plea of guilty accepted under this section has the same effect as if it were entered on arraignment.

heading: Arraignment in presence of jury panel
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "217", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused has not pleaded guilty to all of the charges on an indictment—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "217", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused must be arraigned in the presence of the jury panel or, if a jury panel is split into 2 or more parts under section 30(5) of the Juries Act 2000, the first part of the jury panel that is present in court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "217", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a jury for the trial must be empanelled from that jury panel.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "217", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A trial commences when arraignment under this section occurs: see section 210.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "217", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Juries Act 2000 sets out the process for empanelling a 2 jury.

heading: Special pleas in addition to plea of not guilty
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "218", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On arraignment, an accused may enter a special plea in addition to pleading not guilty.

heading: Plea of guilty to alternative offence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "219", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "219", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On arraignment, an accused may plead not guilty to the offence charged but guilty to another offence of which the accused might be found guilty.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "219", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The consequences of pleading guilty to another offence under subsection (1) are the same as if the other offence had been charged in the indictment.

heading: Form of plea of previous conviction or previous acquittal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "220", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "220", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a plea of previous conviction, it is sufficient for an accused to state that the accused has been lawfully convicted of the offence charged in the indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "220", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a plea of previous acquittal, it is sufficient for an accused to state that the accused has been lawfully acquitted of the offence charged in the indictment.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 220(3) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 14.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "220", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 246, "rect": {"page": 246, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 313.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 352.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "220", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to Chapter 7A, the rules of common law with respect to autrefois convict and autrefois acquit continue in force in respect of pleas of previous conviction and previous acquittal, respectively.

heading: Refusal to plead
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "221", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "221", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, on arraignment, an accused will not answer directly to a charge on the indictment, the court may order that a plea of not guilty be entered on behalf of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "221", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "221", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the Crimes (Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be Tried) Act 1997 when an accused is or may be unfit to stand trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "223A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Opening addresses
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Opening address by prosecutor
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "224", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "224", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The prosecutor must give an opening address to the jury on the prosecution case against the accused before any evidence is given in the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "224", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If documents have been served and filed by the prosecution under Part 5.5, the prosecutor must restrict himself or herself to the matters set out in those documents when opening the prosecution case, unless the trial judge considers that there are exceptional circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "224", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (2), a change of legal practitioner does not constitute exceptional circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "224", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (2), the prosecutor is not restricted to a verbatim presentation of the summary of the prosecution opening as served and filed under Part 5.5.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "224", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may limit the length of the prosecution opening.

heading: Response of accused to prosecution opening
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In all trials before a jury, immediately after the prosecutor's opening, the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
