text: If documents have been served and filed by the defence under Part 5.5, the accused is restricted to the matters set out in those documents when presenting the response of the accused to the prosecution opening, unless the trial judge considers that there are exceptional circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (2), a change of legal practitioner does not constitute exceptional circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (2), the accused is not restricted to a verbatim presentation of the response of the accused to the summary of the prosecution opening as served and filed under Part 5.5.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "225", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may limit the length of the response of the accused.

heading: Case for the accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Accused entitled to respond after close of prosecution case
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 226 amended by No. 6/2017 s. 4(1) (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "226", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 252, "rect": {"page": 252, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 300.3, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 348.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After the close of the case for the prosecution, an accused is entitled—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to make a submission that there is no case for the accused to answer;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to answer the charge by choosing to give evidence or call other witnesses to give evidence or both;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: not to give evidence or call any witnesses.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 226(1) inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 4(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "226", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 252, "rect": {"page": 252, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 462.3, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 510.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 232A enables the trial judge, with the consent of the prosecution and the accused, to direct that expert witnesses give their evidence concurrently or consecutively. The trial judge may direct that this evidence be given at any stage of the trial, including before the prosecution has closed its case.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 226(2) inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 4(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "226", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 252, "rect": {"page": 252, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 543.3, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 582.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "226", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: When ruling on a no-case submission by an accused, the trial judge may take into account the evidence already given of an expert witness called on behalf of any accused in the trial.

heading: Election when accused is legally represented
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "227", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is represented by a legal practitioner, at the close of the case for the prosecution, the trial judge may question the legal practitioner to determine which of the options referred to in section 226 the accused elects to take.

heading: Election when accused is not legally represented
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused is not represented by a legal practitioner, immediately after the close of the case for the prosecution and in the absence of the jury, the trial judge must inform the accused, in a manner that is likely to be understood by the accused, that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has the right to answer the charge and must choose either—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 228(1)(a)(i) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "228", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)", "(i)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 253, "rect": {"page": 253, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 333.4, "x1": 512.8, "y1": 381.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to give sworn or affirmed evidence, that is, to enter the witness box, take the oath or make an affirmation and say what the accused wants to say in answer to the charge and then to respond to any questions from the prosecution or the court about the evidence of the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to say nothing in answer to the charge; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in either case, the accused may call any witnesses to give evidence at the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "228", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After giving the information referred to in subsection (1), the trial judge must ask the accused what the accused wants to do.

heading: Procedure for joint trials if no-case submission made
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "229", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "229", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to a trial in which 2 or more accused are named on the indictment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "229", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After the close of the case for the prosecution, an accused who wishes to make a submission that there is no case for the accused to answer must do so at that time.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 229(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(k).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "229", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 254, "rect": {"page": 254, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "229", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, after the trial judge has ruled on all no-case submissions, 2 or more accused remain on trial, the accused named first on the indictment must advise the trial judge, in response to questioning under section 227 or 228, which of the options referred to in section 226(b) or (c) the accused elects to take.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "229", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Each accused named subsequently on the indictment is not required to advise the trial judge of the election of that accused until the close of the case for the previously named accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "229", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The cases of all accused must proceed according to the order in which the accused are named on the indictment, unless the trial judge otherwise orders.

heading: Questioning to determine proper course of proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "230", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "230", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to call witnesses to give evidence at the trial, the accused must indicate, when called on by the trial judge to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "230", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the names of those witnesses (other than the accused); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "230", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the order in which those witnesses are to be called.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "230", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused must not present the case of the accused differently to the way indicated to the trial judge under subsection (1) without the leave of the trial judge.

heading: Opening address of accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "231", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "231", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused intends to give evidence, or to call other witnesses on behalf of the accused, or both, the accused is entitled to give an opening address to the jury outlining the evidence that the accused proposes to give or call.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "231", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused gives an opening address, it must be given before the accused gives evidence or calls any other witnesses.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 231(2) inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 5.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "231", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 255, "rect": {"page": 255, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 205.0, "x1": 507.2, "y1": 253.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "231", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 232A enables the trial judge, with the consent of the prosecution and the accused, to direct that expert witnesses give their evidence concurrently or consecutively. The trial judge may direct that this evidence be given at any stage of the trial, including before the prosecution has closed its case.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "231", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may limit the length of the opening address of the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "231", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused is not required to give evidence before any other witness is called on behalf of the accused.

heading: Giving of evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Manner of giving evidence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may permit a person to give evidence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: with the consent of the parties, by the witness reading from the statement of the witness prepared in advance of giving evidence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the person is called in his or her capacity as an expert witness, by the presentation of audio or audiovisual material;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by means of playing an audio or audiovisual recording;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in any other manner that the trial judge considers may be of assistance.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in subsection (1) precludes—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of subsection (1)(b), the questioning of an expert witness by cross-examination or otherwise before, during or after a presentation; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of subsection (1)(c), if unanticipated issues arise during the trial, the trial judge making an order that the witness attend before the court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 232(3) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 21, 69/2009 s. 54(Sch. Pt 2 item 18.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "232", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 256, "rect": {"page": 256, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 218.8, "x1": 128.4, "y1": 276.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section affects the operation of Division 6 of Part 8.2 of this Act, Part IIA of the Evidence (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1958 and sections 29 and 50 of the Evidence Act 2008.

heading: Trial judge may give directions about the giving of concurrent or consecutive evidence by expert witnesses
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 232A inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 3.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "232A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 256, "rect": {"page": 256, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 280.0, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 319.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies despite sections 226 and 231(2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge, with the consent of the prosecution and the accused, may direct that 2 or more expert witnesses give evidence concurrently or consecutively.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining the procedure to be followed for the giving of evidence concurrently or consecutively, the trial judge may direct that any expert witness—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give evidence at any stage of the trial, including after all factual evidence has been adduced on behalf of the prosecution and the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give an oral exposition of the opinion of the expert witness on any issue; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give the opinion of the expert witness of any opinion given by another expert witness; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be examined, cross-examined or re-examined in a particular manner or sequence, including by putting to each expert witness in turn each question relevant to one matter or issue at a time; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: be permitted to ask questions of any other expert witness who is concurrently giving evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may question any expert witness to identify the real issues in dispute between 2 or more expert witnesses, including questioning more than one expert witness at the same time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "232A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section limits any other power the court may have in relation to case management, evidence or witnesses, including expert witnesses.

heading: Introduction of evidence not previously disclosed
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the trial judge gives leave to do so, the prosecutor or the accused may introduce at the trial evidence which was not disclosed in accordance with Part 5.5 and which represents—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of the prosecutor, a substantial departure from the summary of the prosecution opening, if any, as served on the accused and filed in court; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of the accused, a substantial departure from—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the response of the accused to the summary of the prosecution opening; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the response of the accused to the notice of pre-trial admissions—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if any, as served on the prosecution and filed in court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, after the close of the prosecution case, the accused gives evidence which could not reasonably have been foreseen by the prosecution having regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the response of the accused to the summary of the prosecution opening; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the response of the accused to the notice of pre-trial admissions—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as served on the prosecution and filed in court, the trial judge may allow the prosecutor to call evidence in reply.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "233", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section limits any other power of the trial judge to allow the prosecutor to call evidence after the prosecutor has closed the prosecution case.

heading: Prosecution closing address
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "234", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "234", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The prosecution is entitled to address the jury for the purpose of summing up the evidence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "234", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: after the close of all evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "234", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: before the closing address of the accused, if any, under section 235.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "234", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to section 236, the prosecution is not entitled to any further or other right to address the jury following the close of evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "234", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may limit the length of the closing address of the prosecution.

heading: Closing address of the accused
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "235", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "235", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused is entitled to address the jury for the purpose of summing up the evidence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "235", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: after the close of all evidence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "235", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: after the closing address of the prosecution, if any, under section 234.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "235", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may limit the length of the closing address of the accused.

heading: Supplementary prosecution address
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "236", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "236", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, in the closing address of the accused under section 235, the accused asserts facts which are not supported by any evidence that is before the jury, the trial judge may grant leave to the prosecution to make a supplementary address to the jury.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "236", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A supplementary address must be confined to replying to the assertion referred to in subsection (1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "236", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge may limit the length of a supplementary address.

heading: Comment on departure or failure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "237", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: Subject to subsection (2), the trial judge or, with the leave of the trial judge, a party may make any comment that the trial judge thinks appropriate on—

text: a failure by a party to comply with a requirement of this Chapter or an order made under this Chapter.

heading: Judge's directions to the jury
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "238", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: At the conclusion of the closing address of the prosecution, the closing address of the accused and any supplementary prosecution address, the trial judge must give directions to the jury so as to enable the jury to properly consider its verdict.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 238 inserted by No. 12/2013 s. 30, substituted by No. 14/2015 s. 69(5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "238", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 260, "rect": {"page": 260, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 311.8, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 378.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "238", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the Jury Directions Act 2015.

heading: Alternative verdicts and discharge of jury from delivering verdict
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Alternative verdicts on charges other than treason or murder
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "239", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "239", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On a trial on indictment for an offence other than treason or murder, if the jury finds the accused not guilty of the offence charged but the allegations in the indictment amount to or include, whether expressly or impliedly, an allegation of another offence that is within the jurisdiction of the court, the jury may find the accused guilty of that other offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "239", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1), an allegation of an offence includes an allegation of an attempt to commit the offence.

heading: Judge may order that guilt in respect of alternative offences is not to be determined
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "240", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 421(1) of the Crimes Act 1958 and section 239, if the trial judge considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so, the judge may order that the guilt of the accused in respect of all or any of the other offences of which the accused may be found guilty is not to be determined at the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "240", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Crimes Act 1958 contains other provisions concerning alternative verdicts.

heading: When judge may enter finding of guilty or not guilty
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If, during trial, an accused is re-arraigned and pleads guilty to a charge on the indictment, the trial judge may discharge the jury from delivering a verdict on the charge and instead direct that an entry of guilty be made on the record in respect of that charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: during trial the prosecution informs the trial judge that the prosecution proposes not to lead evidence on a charge on the indictment; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at the close of the case for the prosecution, the trial judge decides that there is no case for the accused to answer in respect of a charge on the indictment—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the trial judge may discharge the jury from delivering a verdict on the charge and instead direct that an entry of not guilty be made on the record in respect of that charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.7", "division": "8", "subdivision": null, "section": "241", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An entry of guilty under subsection (1) or an entry of not guilty under subsection (2) has the same effect as if it were the verdict of a jury on the trial of the accused on that charge.

heading: Transfer and hearing of charges for related and unrelated summary offences
history_json: [{"raw": "Pt 5.8 Div. 1 (Heading) amended by No. 38/2022 s. 78.", "kind": "amendment", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": "1", "part": "5.8", "def_name": null, "page": 263, "rect": {"page": 263, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 187.9, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 236.3}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:05:14.583853+00:00"}]

heading: Transfer of summary offence between Supreme Court and County Court
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 241A inserted by No. 38/2022 s. 79.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "241A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 263, "rect": {"page": 263, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 246.0, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 285.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "241A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "241A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order is made under section 167(1) in relation to an indictable offence, the Supreme Court may order that a proceeding in respect of a charge against the accused for a summary offence be transferred from the Supreme Court to the County Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "241A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order is made under section 167(2) in relation to an indictable offence, the Supreme Court may order that a proceeding in respect of a charge against the accused for a summary offence be transferred from the County Court to the Supreme Court.

heading: Summary offence related to indictable offence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused before the Supreme Court or the County Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: pleads guilty to an indictable offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is found guilty or not guilty of an indictable offence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may hear and determine a charge for a related summary offence before sentencing or otherwise dealing with the accused.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 242(1A) inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 6(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "242", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 263, "rect": {"page": 263, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 611.3, "x1": 507.2, "y1": 650.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If all charges for an indictable offence against an accused before the Supreme Court or the County Court have been discontinued, the court may hear and determine a charge for a related summary offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must hear and determine a charge for a related summary offence without a jury and in accordance with Part 3.3, as far as practicable.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without affecting the admissibility of any evidence which might be given apart from this subsection, on the hearing of a charge against an accused for a related summary offence, the court may admit as evidence in relation to the charge—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 242(3)(a) amended by No. 6/2017 s. 6(2)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "242", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 264, "rect": {"page": 264, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 286.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 325.1}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:05:38.580289+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: evidence given during a trial of the accused in respect of the indictable offence;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 242(3)(b) amended by No. 6/2017 s. 6(2)(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "242", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 264, "rect": {"page": 264, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 339.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 378.5}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:05:39.982353+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a plea of guilty to the indictable offence, the depositions and all exhibits and all recordings referred to in section 139 that were admitted in evidence in the committal proceeding in relation to the indictable offence;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 242(3)(c) inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 6(2)(c).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "242", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 264, "rect": {"page": 264, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 428.2, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 467.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the case of a discontinuance of prosecution of an indictable offence against the accused, the depositions and all exhibits and all recordings referred to in section 139 that were admitted in evidence in the committal proceeding in relation to the indictable offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party may adduce further evidence only with the leave of the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court considers it appropriate to do so, the court may transfer a proceeding for a related summary offence back to the Magistrates' Court for hearing and determination.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 242(6) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(l).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "242", "sub_path": ["(6)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 264, "rect": {"page": 264, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 625.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 664.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may impose any sentence in respect of a related summary offence that could be imposed by the Magistrates' Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of related summary offence in section 3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "242", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Supreme Court or the County Court may hear and determine a charge against an accused for a summary offence that is not a related summary offence if the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is before the court in respect of an indictable offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: consents to the court hearing and determining the charge for the summary offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: states an intention to plead guilty to the charge for the summary offence.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 243(1A) inserted by No. 6/2017 s. 7.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "243", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 265, "rect": {"page": 265, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 428.7, "x1": 507.2, "y1": 467.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If all charges for an indictable offence against an accused before the Supreme Court or the County Court have been discontinued, the court may hear and determine a charge for a summary offence that is not a related summary offence if the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: consents to the court hearing and determining the charge for the summary offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: states an intention to plead guilty to the charge for the summary offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused consents to the court hearing and determining a charge for a summary offence that is not a related summary offence, the proceeding in respect of the charge is transferred from the Magistrates' Court to the Supreme Court or the County Court, as the case may be.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A charge-sheet for a summary offence may only be filed in the Magistrates' Court. See section 6.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must hear and determine the charge for the summary offence without a jury and in accordance with Part 3.3, as far as practicable.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: does not plead guilty to the charge for the summary offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: states an intention to plead not guilty to the charge for the summary offence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is to direct that the charge be transferred to the Magistrates' Court for hearing and determination.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may impose any sentence in respect of the summary offence that could be imposed by the Magistrates' Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "243", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definitions of originating court and original jurisdiction in section 3 in relation to rights of appeal under Part 6.3.

heading: Criminal record
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Criminal record
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal record must contain, in relation to each previous conviction—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the date of the previous conviction; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court in which the previous conviction took place; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the place of sitting of that court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the offence committed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the sentence imposed.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 244(1) inserted by No. 81/2011 s. 15(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "244", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 267, "rect": {"page": 267, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Previous conviction is defined by section 3 to refer only to a conviction or finding of guilt made by a court and does not include an infringement conviction.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If other offences were taken into account when a sentence was imposed in respect of a previous conviction, a criminal record may contain a statement to that effect and the offences taken into account, including the number of offences.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 244(2A) inserted by No. 81/2011 s. 15(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "244", "sub_path": ["(2A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 267, "rect": {"page": 267, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 290.5, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 329.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal record must contain, in relation to an infringement conviction—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the date on which the infringement notice took effect as a conviction; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the offence specified in the notice; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the amount specified in the notice as the penalty for the infringement; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other penalty that results from the operation of the notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "2A", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A period of cancellation, disqualification or suspension of a licence or permit.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A criminal record is inadmissible as evidence against the person to whom it relates in a proceeding for an offence unless the criminal record is signed by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a police officer; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a Crown Prosecutor; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "244", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a member of staff of the Office of Public Prosecutions who is a legal practitioner; or

heading: Proof of previous convictions and infringement convictions by criminal record
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 245 (Heading) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 16(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "245", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 268, "rect": {"page": 268, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 244.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 292.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 245(1) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 16(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "245", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 268, "rect": {"page": 268, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 298.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 337.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the prosecution intends to allege, in the event of a finding of guilt against a person, that the person has previous convictions or infringement convictions, the prosecution may file the criminal record of the person in court at any time after the indictment is filed and before the sentencing hearing commences.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the criminal record of the person is not available before the sentencing hearing commences, the prosecution may file it in court at any time before sentencing, if the court considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 245(3) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 16(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "245", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 268, "rect": {"page": 268, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 475.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 514.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is found guilty of an offence and the criminal record of the person has been filed in court, the court must ask the person whether the person admits the previous convictions and infringement convictions set out in the criminal record.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 245(4) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 16(4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "245", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 268, "rect": {"page": 268, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 564.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 603.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person may admit, orally or in writing on the criminal record, all or any of the previous convictions or infringement convictions set out in the criminal record.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 245(5) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 16(5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "245", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 268, "rect": {"page": 268, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 625.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 664.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the person admits to a previous conviction or infringement conviction, the court may sentence the person accordingly.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 245(6) amended by No. 81/2011 s. 16(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "245", "sub_path": ["(6)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 269, "rect": {"page": 269, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the person does not admit to a previous conviction or infringement conviction, the prosecution may lead evidence to prove the previous conviction or infringement conviction.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "245", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 178 of the Evidence Act 2008 provides for proof of previous convictions by the filing of a certificate.

heading: Powers and obligations
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Attendance of accused at hearings
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "246", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused must attend all hearings conducted under this Chapter in the criminal proceeding against the accused unless excused under section 330.

heading: Power to extend or abridge time
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court, by order, may extend or abridge any time fixed—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by or under this Chapter; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by any order extending or abridging time made under this section—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An extension of the time for commencement of a trial for a sexual offence must not exceed 3 months.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: It is not necessary that an order be made under subsection (1) if a ruling made, or direction given, by the court provides for the extension or abridgment of time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may extend time under subsection (1) before or after the time expires.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: More than one extension of time may be granted under subsection (1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "247", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Unless the court otherwise orders, no material in support of an order under subsection (1) need be filed.

heading: Parties must inform Juries Commissioner of certain events
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "248", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a party to a criminal proceeding listed for trial before a jury becomes aware of any event that affects—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "248", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether or not a jury will be required for the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "248", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when a jury will be required for the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "248", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the dates on which persons will be required to attend for jury service—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "248", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the party must inform the Juries Commissioner as soon as practicable after the party becomes aware of the event.

heading: Counsel required to retain brief for trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "249", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "249", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A legal practitioner who has been briefed or otherwise agreed to appear for an accused at a trial must, at least 7 days before the day on which the trial is due to commence, advise the court of his or her intention to appear for the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "249", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A legal practitioner may only relinquish a brief to appear or withdraw from an agreement to appear for an accused within 7 days before the day on which the trial is due to commence with the leave of the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "249", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application for leave under subsection (2), the court may make an order as to costs to be paid personally by the legal practitioner if the court considers that in the circumstances of the case—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "249", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the agreement to appear at trial for the accused or the acceptance of a brief to appear for the accused at trial is unreasonable; or

text: the withdrawal from an agreement to appear for the accused at trial or the relinquishment of a brief to appear for the accused at trial is unreasonable.

heading: Judge at earlier trial not prevented from presiding at later trial
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "251", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "251", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if an offence charged in an indictment and an offence that was tried at an earlier trial are the same or related offences.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "251", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The trial judge at an earlier trial, or a judge who conducted a directions hearing or other pre-trial hearing in relation to the earlier trial, is not prevented from being the trial judge at the later trial merely because the judge made a decision in relation to the earlier trial on any issue of law or procedure that, in his or her opinion, is likely to be contentious in the later trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "251", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of related offences in section 3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "252", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: A corporate accused must comply with an order made under section 144(2)(d).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "252", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Penalty: 240 penalty units.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "252", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "5", "part": "5.8", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "252", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Penalty: 240 penalty units.

text: An appeal under section 254 is commenced by filing a notice of appeal with a registrar of the Magistrates' Court at any venue of the Magistrates' Court within 28 days after the day on which the sentence of the Magistrates' Court is imposed.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 255(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zo).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "255", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 275, "rect": {"page": 275, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
