heading: Determination of DPP's appeal—failure to fulfil undertaking
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "262", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "262", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under section 260 must not be conducted as a rehearing.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 262(2) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 69(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "262", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 281, "rect": {"page": 281, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 523.0, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 562.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "262", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 260, if the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires, considers that the respondent has failed, wholly or partly, to fulfil the undertaking referred to in section 260(1)(a), the court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "262", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: set aside the sentence imposed by the Magistrates' Court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "262", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: impose the sentence that it considers appropriate, having regard to the failure of the respondent to fulfil the undertaking.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 262(3) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 69(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "262", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 282, "rect": {"page": 282, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "262", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In imposing a sentence under subsection (2), the court must not take into account the element of double jeopardy involved in the respondent being sentenced again, in order to impose a less severe sentence than the court would otherwise consider appropriate.

heading: Procedure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Late notice of appeal deemed to be application for leave to appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of appeal filed after the end of the period referred to in section 255(1) or 258 is deemed to be an application for leave to appeal on the grounds stated in the notice.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 263(2) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 70(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "263", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 282, "rect": {"page": 282, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 369.3, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 408.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires, may grant leave to appeal under subsection (1) and the appellant may proceed with the appeal if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that the failure to file a notice of appeal within the period referred to in section 255(1) or 258 was due to exceptional circumstances; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the respondent's case would not be materially prejudiced because of the delay.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 263(3) inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 16, amended by No. 3/2016 s. 70(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "263", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 282, "rect": {"page": 282, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 539.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 605.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court does not grant leave to appeal under subsection (2), the court must strike out the appeal.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 263(4) inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 16, amended by Nos 3/2016 s. 70(3)(b), 1/2022 s. 67.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "263", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 283, "rect": {"page": 283, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 239.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 263(4)(a) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 70(3)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "263", "sub_path": ["(4)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 283, "rect": {"page": 283, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 256.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 295.7}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:13:46.069929+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires, strikes out an appeal under subsection (3); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appellant had been sentenced to a term of imprisonment or detention by the Magistrates' Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 263(5) inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 16.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "263", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 283, "rect": {"page": 283, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 440.2, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 479.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an appeal is struck out under subsection (3)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "263", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Stay of sentence
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 264 (Heading) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(m).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "264", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 284, "rect": {"page": 284, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "264", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "264", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an appellant appeals against sentence and is not in custody because of that sentence, the appeal operates as a stay of the sentence (but not a conviction in respect of the sentence) when the appellant files the notice of appeal and signs the undertaking referred to in section 255(5).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "264", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an appellant appeals against sentence and is in custody because of that sentence, the appeal operates as a stay of the sentence (but not a conviction in respect of the sentence) when—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "264", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appellant files the notice of appeal and signs the undertaking referred to in section 255(5); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "264", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appellant enters bail, if bail is granted under section 265.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "264", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section is subject to section 29 of the Road Safety Act 1986.

heading: Bail pending appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "265", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "265", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an appellant is in custody because of the sentence appealed against and wishes to be released pending the appeal, the appellant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "265", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "265", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if he or she makes an application under paragraph (a), must give reasonable notice of the application to the respondent to the appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "265", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an application is made under subsection (1), the Magistrates' Court must either grant or refuse bail as if the appellant were accused of an offence and were being held in custody in relation to that offence and, for this purpose, the Bail Act 1977 (with any necessary modifications) applies.

heading: Abandonment of appeal

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "267", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (3) to set aside an order may be made at any time on notice in writing to the respondent served a reasonable time before the making of the application.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "267", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: If the court grants an application under subsection (3), the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "267", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "267", "subsection": "6A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under section 265 for bail pending the reinstated appeal may be made to the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires.

text: Subsection (7) is subject to section 29 of the Road Safety Act 1986.

heading: Respondent's failure to appear on appeal by DPP
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "268", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 268(1) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 24(3)(a), 3/2016 s. 73.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "268", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 289, "rect": {"page": 289, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 230.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 279.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "268", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a respondent to an appeal under section 257 or 260 by the DPP fails to appear at the time listed for the hearing of the appeal, the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires—

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 268(1)(b) amended by Nos 65/2011 s. 107(Sch. item 4.5) (as amended by No. 43/2012 s. 3(Sch. item 47.3)), 3/2016 s. 73.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "268", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 289, "rect": {"page": 289, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 386.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 490.2}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: The County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires cannot impose a sentence that requires the consent of the respondent, for example a community correction order, in the absence of the respondent.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 268(2) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 24(4), 3/2016 s. 73.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "268", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 289, "rect": {"page": 289, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 495.9, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 544.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "268", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires adjourns the proceeding and is satisfied that notice of the appeal has been given in accordance with section 258 or 261, as the case may be, the court may issue a warrant to arrest the respondent and to bring the respondent before the judge who issued the warrant or any other judge of the court.

heading: One notice of appeal for 2 or more sentences
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "269", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If 2 or more sentences are imposed in respect of charges that have been heard together, the appellant may give one notice of appeal for all or any of those sentences.

heading: Appeal against aggregate sentence
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 270 amended by No. 3/2016 s. 74.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "270", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 290, "rect": {"page": 290, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "270", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On sentencing a person where the sentence appealed against is an aggregate sentence of imprisonment imposed in accordance with section 9(1) of the Sentencing Act 1991 or an aggregate fine imposed in accordance with section 51 of that Act, the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires may rely on any agreed statement of facts (however derived) relevant to any charge contained in the original charge-sheet.

heading: Appeal to County Court authorised by other Acts
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 271 amended by No. 3/2016 s. 75 (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "271", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 290, "rect": {"page": 290, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 321.4, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 369.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "271", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "271", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is authorised by or under any other Act to appeal from an order of the Magistrates' Court to the County Court, subject to that Act, the provisions of this Act with respect to appeals to the County Court apply.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 271(2) inserted by No. 3/2016 s. 75, amended by No. 1/2022 s. 70.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "271", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 290, "rect": {"page": 290, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 416.2, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 482.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "271", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, if the appeal was from the Magistrates' Court constituted by the Chief Magistrate who is a dual commission holder, a reference to the County Court is to be construed as a reference to the Court of Appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "271", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 283 gives a further right of appeal from the County Court to the Court of Appeal in certain circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.1", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "271", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 302A provides for the reservation of a question of law for determination by the Court of Appeal during the hearing of an appeal by the County Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Appeal to Supreme Court on a question of law
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party to a criminal proceeding (other than a committal proceeding) in the Magistrates' Court may appeal to the Supreme Court on a question of law, from a final order of the Magistrates' Court in that proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "10", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An order made by the Supreme Court on an appeal under subsection (1), other than an order remitting the case for rehearing to the Magistrates' Court, may be enforced as an order of the Supreme Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "11", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Supreme Court may provide for a stay of the order or for admitting any person to bail as it considers appropriate.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 272(1A) inserted by No. 1/2022 s. 71.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "272", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 291, "rect": {"page": 291, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 295.1, "x1": 507.2, "y1": 334.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Magistrates' Court was constituted by the Chief Magistrate who is a dual commission holder, the appeal is to be made to the Court of Appeal.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 272(2) amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 41.5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "272", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 291, "rect": {"page": 291, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 356.3, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 404.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an informant who is a police officer wishes to appeal under subsection (1), the appeal may be brought only by the DPP on behalf of the informant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under subsection (1) is commenced by filing a notice of appeal in accordance with the rules of the Supreme Court within 28 days after the day on which the order complained of was made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A copy of the notice of appeal must be served on the respondent in accordance with subsection (5) within 7 days after the day on which the notice of appeal was filed.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 272(5) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 49(n).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "272", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 291, "rect": {"page": 291, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 553.7, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 592.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A copy of the notice of appeal must be served—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 272(5)(a) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zr)(i).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "272", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 291, "rect": {"page": 291, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 613.1, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 652.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: personally on a respondent who was the accused in accordance with section 391; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 272(5)(b) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zr)(ii).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "272", "sub_path": ["(5)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 292, "rect": {"page": 292, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: on a respondent who was the informant in accordance with section 392.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under subsection (1) does not operate as a stay of any order made by the Magistrates' Court unless the Supreme Court otherwise orders.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal commenced after the end of the period referred to in subsection (3) is deemed to be an application for leave to appeal under subsection (1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Supreme Court may grant leave under subsection (7) and the appellant may proceed with the appeal if the Supreme Court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is of the opinion that the failure to commence the appeal within the period referred to in subsection (3) was due to exceptional circumstances; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is satisfied that the case of any other party to the appeal would not be materially prejudiced because of the delay.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "272", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: After hearing and determining the appeal, the Supreme Court may make any order that it thinks appropriate, including an order remitting the case for rehearing to the Magistrates' Court with or without any direction in law.

heading: Appeal on question of law precludes appeal to County Court
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "273", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person appeals under this Part to the Supreme Court on a question of law, that person abandons finally and conclusively any right under this or any other Act to appeal to the County Court in relation to that proceeding.

heading: Appeal and case stated from County Court or Trial Division of Supreme Court to Court of Appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Appeal against conviction
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Right of appeal against conviction
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "274", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person convicted of an offence by an originating court may appeal to the Court of Appeal against the conviction on any ground of appeal if the Court of Appeal gives the person leave to appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "274", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definitions of conviction, originating court and original jurisdiction in section 3.

heading: How appeal is commenced
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "275", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "275", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for leave to appeal under section 274 is commenced by filing a notice of application for leave to appeal in accordance with the rules of court within 28 days after the day on which the person is sentenced or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "275", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Registrar of Criminal Appeals of the Supreme Court must provide to the respondent a copy of the notice of application for leave to appeal within 7 days after the day on which the notice of application is filed.

heading: Determination of appeal against conviction
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "276", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "276", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 274, the Court of Appeal must allow the appeal against conviction if the appellant satisfies the court that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "276", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the verdict of the jury is unreasonable or cannot be supported having regard to the evidence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "276", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as the result of an error or an irregularity in, or in relation to, the trial there has been a substantial miscarriage of justice; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "276", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for any other reason there has been a substantial miscarriage of justice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "276", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In any other case, the Court of Appeal must dismiss an appeal under section 274.

heading: Orders etc. on successful appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal allows an appeal under section 274, it must set aside the conviction of the offence (offence A) and must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: order a new trial of offence A; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: enter a judgment of acquittal of offence A; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appellant could have been found guilty of some other offence (offence B) instead of offence A; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 277(1)(c)(ii) amended by No. 6/2017 s. 8.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "277", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(c)", "(ii)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 295, "rect": {"page": 295, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 446.2, "x1": 514.5, "y1": 485.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the jury or, in the case of a plea of guilty to offence A, the trial judge must have been satisfied of facts that prove the appellant was guilty of offence B—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: enter a finding of not guilty of offence B because of mental impairment and make an order or declaration under section 23 of the Crimes (Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be Tried) Act 1997.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: enter a judgment of conviction of offence B and impose a sentence for offence B that is no more severe than the sentence that was imposed for offence A; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the appellant could have been found guilty of some other offence (offence B) instead of offence A and the court is not satisfied as required by paragraph (c)(ii), order a new trial for offence B;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court is satisfied that the appellant should have been found not guilty of offence A because of mental impairment, enter a finding of not guilty because of mental impairment and make an order or declaration under section 23 of the Crimes (Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be Tried) Act 1997; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the appellant could have been found guilty of some other offence (offence B) instead of offence A and the court is satisfied—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the jury must have been satisfied of facts that prove the appellant did the acts or made the omissions that constitute offence B; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the appellant should have been found not guilty of offence B because of mental impairment—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 277(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 25(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "277", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 296, "rect": {"page": 296, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 463.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 502.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal orders a new trial, the court must order that the appellant attend on a specified date before the court in which the new trial will be conducted.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 277(2) inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 25(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "277", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 296, "rect": {"page": 296, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 524.8, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 573.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 323 enables the Court of Appeal to remand the appellant in custody or grant bail pending a new trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal sets aside the conviction of offence A, it may vary a sentence that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was imposed for an offence other than offence A at or after the time when the appellant was sentenced for offence A; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: took into account the sentence for offence A.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A power of the Court of Appeal under this section to impose a sentence in substitution for the sentence imposed by the originating court may still be exercised even if the sentence imposed by the originating court is an aggregate sentence of imprisonment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If at the conclusion of an appeal the appellant remains convicted of more than one offence, the Court of Appeal may either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: impose a separate sentence in respect of each offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "277", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: impose an aggregate sentence of imprisonment in respect of all offences or any 2 or more offences.

heading: Appeal by offender against sentence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Right of appeal against sentence imposed by originating court
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "278", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person sentenced for an offence by an originating court may appeal to the Court of Appeal against the sentence imposed if the Court of Appeal gives the person leave to appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "278", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definitions of originating court and original jurisdiction in section 3.

heading: How appeal is commenced
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "279", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "279", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for leave to appeal under section 278 is commenced by filing a notice of application for leave to appeal in accordance with the rules of court within 28 days after the day on which the person is sentenced or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "279", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Registrar of Criminal Appeals of the Supreme Court must provide to the respondent a copy of the notice of application for leave to appeal within 7 days after the day on which the notice of application is filed.

heading: Determination of application for leave to appeal under section 278
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 280 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 26, substituted by No. 48/2012 s. 5.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "280", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 298, "rect": {"page": 298, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 232.6, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 299.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may refuse an application for leave to appeal under section 278 in relation to any ground of appeal if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is no reasonable prospect that the Court of Appeal would impose a less severe sentence than the sentence first imposed; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is no reasonable prospect that the Court of Appeal would reduce the total effective sentence despite there being an error in the sentence first imposed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (3) empowers the Court of Appeal to correct a sentence if an application is refused in the circumstances referred to in subsection (1)(b).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application may be refused under subsection (1) even if the Court of Appeal considers that there may be a reasonably arguable ground of appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On refusing an application by reason of subsection (1)(b), the Court of Appeal may, if it considers it appropriate to do so—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: amend the sentence first imposed by substituting a less severe sentence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: make any other order that the Court of Appeal considers ought to be made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "280", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an application for leave to appeal is heard and refused by a single Judge of Appeal under section 315(1), section 315(2) entitles the applicant to have the application determined by the Court of Appeal.

heading: Determination of appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "281", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "281", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 278, the Court of Appeal must allow the appeal if the appellant satisfies the court that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "281", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is an error in the sentence first imposed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "281", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a different sentence should be imposed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "281", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In any other case, the Court of Appeal must dismiss an appeal under section 278.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "281", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal is considering imposing a more severe sentence than the sentence first imposed, the Court of Appeal must warn the appellant, as early as possible during the hearing of the appeal, that the appellant faces the possibility that a more severe sentence may be imposed than that first imposed.

heading: Orders etc. on successful appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal allows an appeal under section 278, it must set aside the sentence imposed by the originating court and either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: impose the sentence, whether more or less severe, that it considers appropriate; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: remit the matter to the originating court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal imposes a sentence under subsection (1)(a), it may make any other order that it considers ought to be made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal remits a matter to the originating court under subsection (1)(b)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "282", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the originating court, whether constituted by the same judge or a different judge, must hear and determine the matter in accordance with the directions, if any.

heading: Right of appeal against sentence of imprisonment imposed by County Court on appeal from Magistrates' Court
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: imprisonment
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "imprisonment"}
text: includes detention in a youth justice centre or youth residential centre but does not include imprisonment in default of payment of a fine.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 283(2) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 76.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "283", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 300, "rect": {"page": 300, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 455.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 494.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person sentenced to a term of imprisonment by the County Court or the Supreme Court, as the case requires under section 256, 259 or 262 may appeal to the Court of Appeal against the sentence if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the proceeding that is the subject of the appeal, the Magistrates' Court had not ordered that the person be imprisoned; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Court of Appeal gives the person leave to appeal.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 283(3) inserted by No. 1/2022 s. 72.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "283", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 300, "rect": {"page": 300, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 611.8, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 650.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "283", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) does not apply if in the proceeding that is the subject of the appeal, the Magistrates' Court was constituted by the Chief Magistrate who is a dual commission holder.

heading: How appeal is commenced
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 284(1) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 77.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "284", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 301, "rect": {"page": 301, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 177.4, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 216.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for leave to appeal under section 283 is commenced by filing a notice of application for leave to appeal in accordance with the rules of court within 28 days after the day on which the person is sentenced by the court or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Registrar of Criminal Appeals of the Supreme Court must provide to the respondent a copy of the notice of application for leave to appeal within 7 days after the day on which the notice of application is filed.

heading: Determination of application for leave to appeal under section 283
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 284A inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 27, substituted by No. 48/2012 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "284A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 301, "rect": {"page": 301, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 355.0, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 421.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may refuse an application for leave to appeal under section 283 in relation to any ground of appeal if—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 284A(1)(a) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 78.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "284A", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 301, "rect": {"page": 301, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 436.0, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 475.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is no reasonable prospect that the Court of Appeal would impose a less severe sentence than the sentence imposed by the court; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 284A(1)(b) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 78.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "284A", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 301, "rect": {"page": 301, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 497.2, "x1": 512.5, "y1": 536.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is no reasonable prospect that the Court of Appeal would reduce the total effective sentence despite there being an error in the sentence imposed by the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (3) empowers the Court of Appeal to correct a sentence if an application is refused in the circumstances referred to in subsection (1)(b).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application may be refused under subsection (1) even if the Court of Appeal considers that there may be a reasonably arguable ground of appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On refusing an application by reason of subsection (1)(b), the Court of Appeal may, if it considers it appropriate to do so—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 284A(3)(a) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 78.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "284A", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 302, "rect": {"page": 302, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 205.0, "x1": 123.6, "y1": 244.1}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:20:52.459613+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: amend the sentence imposed by the court by substituting a less severe sentence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: make any other order that the Court of Appeal considers ought to be made.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "284A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an application for leave to appeal is heard and refused by a single Judge of Appeal under section 315(1), section 315(2) entitles the applicant to have the application determined by the Court of Appeal.

heading: Determination of appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "285", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "285", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 283, the Court of Appeal must allow the appeal if the appellant satisfies the court that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "285", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is an error in the sentence imposed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "285", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "285", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 285(3) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 79.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "285", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 302, "rect": {"page": 302, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 501.9, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 541.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "285", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 286(2) amended by No. 3/2016 s. 80(c).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "286", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 303, "rect": {"page": 303, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 305.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 344.9}, "confidence": "high"}]

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Right of appeal—inadequate sentence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "287", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP may appeal to the Court of Appeal against a sentence imposed by an originating court if the DPP—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "287", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "287", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is satisfied that an appeal should be brought in the public interest.

heading: How appeal is commenced
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "288", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "288", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under section 287 is commenced by filing a notice of appeal in accordance with the rules of court within 28 days after the day on which the sentence is imposed or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "288", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice of appeal under subsection (1) must be signed by the DPP personally.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 288(3) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zs).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "288", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 304, "rect": {"page": 304, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 286.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 325.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "288", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A copy of the notice of appeal must be served personally on the respondent in accordance with section 391 within 7 days after the day on which the notice of appeal is filed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "288", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The DPP must provide a copy of the notice of appeal to the legal practitioner who last represented the respondent in the criminal proceeding to which the appeal relates, if that legal practitioner can reasonably be identified.

heading: Determination of Crown appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "289", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "289", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 287, the Court of Appeal must allow the appeal if the DPP satisfies the court that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "289", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is an error in the sentence first imposed; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "289", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a different sentence should be imposed.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 289(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 28.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "289", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 304, "rect": {"page": 304, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 542.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 581.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "289", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In considering whether an appeal should be allowed, the Court of Appeal must not take into account any element of double jeopardy involved in the respondent being sentenced again, if the appeal is allowed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "289", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In any other case, the Court of Appeal must dismiss an appeal under section 287.

heading: Orders etc. on successful appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: If the Court of Appeal allows an appeal under section 287, it must set aside the sentence imposed by the originating court and impose the sentence, whether more or less severe, that it considers appropriate.

text: If the Court of Appeal imposes a sentence under subsection (1), it may make any other order that it considers ought to be made.

text: In imposing a sentence under subsection (1), the Court of Appeal must not take into account the element of double jeopardy involved in the respondent being sentenced again, in order to impose a less severe sentence than the court would otherwise consider appropriate.

heading: Right of appeal against certain sentences imposed by County Court or Supreme Court on appeal from Magistrates' Court
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 290A inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 36.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "290A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 305, "rect": {"page": 305, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 388.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 427.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 290A(3) inserted by No. 1/2022 s. 73.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "290A", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 306, "rect": {"page": 306, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 118.8, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subsection (2) does not apply if in the proceeding that is the subject of the appeal, the Magistrates' Court was constituted by the Chief Magistrate who is a dual commission holder.

heading: How appeal is commenced
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 290B inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 36.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "290B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 306, "rect": {"page": 306, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 218.8, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 257.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290B", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under section 290A is commenced by filing a notice of appeal in accordance with the rules of court within 28 days after the day on which the sentence is imposed or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290B", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290B", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Determination of Crown appeal under section 290A
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 290C inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 36.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "290C", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 306, "rect": {"page": 306, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 483.4, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 522.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 290A, the Court of Appeal must allow the appeal if the DPP satisfies the court that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: there is an error in the sentence imposed by the County Court or the Trial Division of the Supreme Court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
