path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In considering whether an appeal should be allowed, the Court of Appeal must not take into account any element of double jeopardy involved in the respondent being sentenced again, if the appeal is allowed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In any other case, the Court of Appeal must dismiss an appeal under section 290A.

heading: Orders etc. on successful appeal
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 290D inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 36.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "290D", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 307, "rect": {"page": 307, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 191.2, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290D", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal allows an appeal under section 290A, it must set aside the sentence imposed by the County Court or the Trial Division of the Supreme Court and impose the sentence, whether more or less severe, that it considers appropriate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "290D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: In imposing a sentence under subsection (1), the Court of Appeal must not take into account the element of double jeopardy involved in the respondent being sentenced again, in order to impose a less severe sentence than the court would otherwise consider appropriate.

heading: Right of appeal—failure to fulfil undertaking
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "291", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "292", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "294", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "294", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Interlocutory appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Right of appeal against interlocutory decision
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to a proceeding in the County Court or the Trial Division of the Supreme Court for the prosecution of an indictable offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to this section, a party to a proceeding referred to in subsection (1) may appeal to the Court of Appeal against an interlocutory decision made in the proceeding if the Court of Appeal gives the party leave to appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of interlocutory decision in section 3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party may not seek leave to appeal unless the judge who made the interlocutory decision certifies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the interlocutory decision concerns the admissibility of evidence, that the evidence, if ruled inadmissible, would eliminate or substantially weaken the prosecution case; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the interlocutory decision does not concern the admissibility of evidence, that the interlocutory decision is otherwise of sufficient importance to the trial to justify it being determined on an interlocutory appeal; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the interlocutory decision is made after the trial commences, either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the issue that is the subject of the proposed appeal was not reasonably able to be identified before the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the party was not at fault in failing to identify the issue that is the subject of the proposed appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "295", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A request for certification under subsection (3) must be determined as soon as practicable after the request is made.

heading: Review of refusal to certify
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a judge refuses to certify under section 295(3), the party which requested certification may apply to the Court of Appeal, in accordance with the rules of court, for review of the decision.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for review under subsection (1) is commenced by filing a notice of application for review in accordance with the rules of court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to paragraph (b), if the trial has not commenced when the judge refuses to certify, within 10 days after the day on which the judge refuses to certify or any extension of that period granted under section 313; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the trial commences within 10 days after the day on which the judge refuses to certify, within 2 days after the day on which the trial commences or any extension of that period granted under section 313; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the trial has commenced when the judge refuses to certify, within 2 days after the day on which the judge refuses to certify or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 296(3) substituted by No. 68/2009 s. 30(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "296", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 311, "rect": {"page": 311, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 191.2, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A copy of the notice of application for review must be served on the respondent in accordance with section 392 or 394, as the case requires, within the relevant period specified in subsection (2) for filing the notice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On a review under subsection (1), the Court of Appeal—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must consider the matters referred to in section 295(3); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "296", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if satisfied as required by section 297, may give the applicant leave to appeal against the interlocutory decision.

heading: When leave to appeal may be given
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (2), the Court of Appeal may give leave to appeal against an interlocutory decision only if the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so, having regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the extent of any disruption or delay to the trial process that may arise if leave is given; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the determination of the appeal against the interlocutory decision may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: render the trial unnecessary; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: substantially reduce the time required for the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: resolve an issue of law, evidence or procedure that is necessary for the proper conduct of the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: reduce the likelihood of a successful appeal against conviction in the event that the accused is convicted at trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other matter that the court considers relevant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal must not give leave to appeal after the trial has commenced, unless the reasons for doing so clearly outweigh any disruption to the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "297", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal refuses leave to appeal under this section, the refusal does not preclude any other appeal on the issue that was the subject of the proposed appeal.

heading: How interlocutory appeal is commenced
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "298", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "298", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An interlocutory appeal under section 295 is commenced by filing a notice of application for leave to appeal in accordance with the rules of court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "298", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to paragraph (b), if the trial has not commenced when the interlocutory decision is made, within 10 days after the day on which the interlocutory decision is made or any extension of that period granted under section 313; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "298", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the trial commences within 10 days after the day on which the interlocutory decision is made, within 2 days after the day on which the trial commences or any extension of that period granted under section 313; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "298", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the trial has commenced when the interlocutory decision is made, within 2 days after the day on which the interlocutory decision is made or any extension of that period granted under section 313.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 298(2) substituted by No. 68/2009 s. 30(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "298", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 312, "rect": {"page": 312, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 633.4, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 672.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "298", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A copy of the notice of application for leave to appeal must be served on the respondent in accordance with section 392 or 394, as the case requires, within the relevant period specified in subsection (1) for filing the notice.

heading: Adjournment of trial if leave to appeal given
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "299", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal gives leave to appeal against an interlocutory decision after the trial has commenced, the trial judge must adjourn the trial without discharging the jury, if reasonably practicable, until the appeal has been determined.

heading: Determination of appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal against an interlocutory decision is to be determined on the evidence, if any, given in the proceeding to which the appeal relates, unless the Court of Appeal gives leave to adduce additional evidence.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 300(2) amended by No. 32/2024 s. 824.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "300", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 313, "rect": {"page": 313, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 347.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 386.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 295, other than an appeal against a determination that the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted, the Court of Appeal—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may affirm or set aside the interlocutory decision; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if it sets aside the interlocutory decision—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may make any other decision that the Court of Appeal considers ought to have been made; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: remit the matter to the court which made the interlocutory decision for determination.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal remits a matter under subsection (2)(b)(ii)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it may give directions concerning the basis on which the matter is to be determined; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court to which the matter is remitted must hear and determine the matter in accordance with the directions, if any.

heading: Determination of appeal—interlocutory decision on presumption against criminal responsibility
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 300A inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 825.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "300A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 314, "rect": {"page": 314, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to an appeal under section 295 against an interlocutory decision that the presumption against criminal responsibility has been rebutted in respect of a charge for an offence allegedly committed by a person at 12 or 13 years of age.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The appeal is to be determined on the evidence, if any, given in the proceeding to which the appeal relates, unless the Court of Appeal gives leave to adduce additional evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite section 300(2), the Court of Appeal—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may affirm the decision that the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may set aside the decision and enter a judgment of acquittal of the relevant offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On affirming a decision that the presumption against criminal responsibility is rebutted, the Court of Appeal may order that the matter proceed to trial or to the determination of other pre-trial issues (as the case requires).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A judgment of acquittal of the relevant offence under subsection (3)(b)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has the same effect as if it were a verdict of not guilty by the jury on the trial of the accused for the charge for the offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "300A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is to be entered on the record of the court that made the decision as a decision of not guilty.

heading: Determination of interlocutory appeal to be entered on record
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "4", "subdivision": null, "section": "301", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Registrar of Criminal Appeals of the Supreme Court must transmit the decision of the Court of Appeal to the court which made the interlocutory decision and that court must enter the decision on the court record.

heading: Case stated for Court of Appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Reservation of question of law
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to a proceeding in the County Court or the Trial Division of the Supreme Court for the prosecution of an indictable offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In a proceeding referred to in subsection (1), if a question of law arises before or during the trial, the court may reserve the question for determination by the Court of Appeal if the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so, having regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the extent of any disruption or delay to the trial process that may arise if the question of law is reserved; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the determination of the question of law may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: render the trial unnecessary; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: substantially reduce the time required for the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: resolve a novel question of law that is necessary for the proper conduct of the trial; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: reduce the likelihood of a successful appeal against conviction in the event that the accused is convicted at trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must not reserve a question of law after the trial has commenced, unless the reasons for doing so clearly outweigh any disruption to the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 33 of the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act 2006 also provides for the referral to the Supreme Court of questions of law that relate to the application of the Charter or the interpretation of a statutory provision in accordance with the Charter.

heading: Reservation of question of law on appeal to County Court
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 302A inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 18, amended by Nos 3/2016 s. 81, 38/2017 s. 83, 1/2022 s. 74.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "302A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 316, "rect": {"page": 316, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 299.8, "x1": 125.7, "y1": 384.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If on the hearing of an appeal under Part 6.1 to the County Court from the Magistrates' Court a question of law arises, the County Court may reserve the question for determination by the Court of Appeal if the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so, having regard to—

text: the extent of any disruption or delay to the hearing that may arise if the question of law is reserved; and

text: whether the determination of the question of law may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: render the hearing unnecessary; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: substantially reduce the time required for the hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "302A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: resolve a novel question of law that is necessary for the proper conduct of the hearing.

heading: Adjournment if question of law reserved
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 303 amended by No. 48/2012 s. 19 (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "303", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 316, "rect": {"page": 316, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 604.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 652.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "303", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "303", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court reserves a question of law under section 302 after the trial has commenced, the court must adjourn the trial without discharging the jury, if reasonably practicable, until the question of law has been determined.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 303(2) inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 19.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "303", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 317, "rect": {"page": 317, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "303", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court reserves a question of law under section 302A, the court must adjourn the hearing, if reasonably practicable, until the question of law has been determined.

heading: Refusal to reserve question of law
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 304(1) amended by No. 48/2012 s. 20(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "304", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 317, "rect": {"page": 317, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 238.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 277.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Supreme Court or the County Court refuses an application under section 302 or 302A to reserve a question of law, the applicant may apply to the Court of Appeal for an order calling on—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court which dismissed the application; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the respondent—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to show cause why the question of law should not be reserved for determination by the Court of Appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application under subsection (1), the Court of Appeal may order that the question of law be reserved for its determination or refuse the application with or without costs.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "304", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal orders that the question of law be reserved, the court to which the order is directed must reserve the question for determination by the Court of Appeal.

heading: Case to be stated if question of law reserved
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "305", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 305(1) amended by No. 48/2012 s. 20(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "305", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 317, "rect": {"page": 317, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 542.8, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 581.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "305", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court reserves a question of law under section 302, 302A or 304, it must state a case, setting out the question and the circumstances in which the question has arisen.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "305", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must sign the case stated and transmit it within a reasonable time to the Court of Appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "305", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: General powers of Court of Appeal on case stated

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "306", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "315", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: takes effect on the refusal of the application for leave to appeal by the Court of Appeal constituted by 2 or more Judges of Appeal;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "315", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is of no effect if the application for leave to appeal is granted by the Court of Appeal constituted by 2 or more Judges of Appeal.

heading: Trial judge may be required to provide report on appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "316", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "316", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Part, the Registrar of Criminal Appeals of the Supreme Court may require a trial judge to provide to the Registrar a report on a case tried by the judge, giving the opinion of the trial judge on the case or on any point arising in the case.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "316", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A trial judge must comply with a requirement under subsection (1) in accordance with the rules of court.

heading: Production of documents, exhibits or other things
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "317", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Part, the Court of Appeal may order the production of any document, exhibit or other thing connected with the proceeding if the Court of Appeal considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

heading: Order for examination of compellable witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "318", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "318", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Part, if the Court of Appeal considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so, the Court of Appeal may order any witness who would have been a compellable witness at the trial to attend and be examined before the court, whether or not the witness was called at the trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "318", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal makes an order under subsection (1), it may order that the examination of the witness be conducted, in accordance with the rules of court, before any person appointed by the Court of Appeal for that purpose.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "318", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may admit as evidence any deposition of a witness taken in an examination under subsection (2).

heading: Evidence of competent but not compellable witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Part, if the Court of Appeal considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so, the Court of Appeal may receive the evidence of any witness (including the appellant) who is a competent but not compellable witness.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: As to competence and compellability of witnesses, see Division 1 of Part 2.1 of Chapter 2 of the Evidence Act 2008.

heading: Court of Appeal may refer issue or matter for reference determination
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 319A inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 34.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "319A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 324, "rect": {"page": 324, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 360.0, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 399.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an appeal under this Part or Part 6.4; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an application for leave to appeal under this Part or Part 6.4.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may refer, for the making of a reference determination, any specified issue or matter arising on an appeal or an application for leave to appeal to which this section applies—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to the Trial Division of the Supreme Court constituted by a Judge of the Court within the meaning of the Supreme Court Act 1986; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to the County Court constituted by a judge within the meaning of the County Court Act 1958.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may make any directions it considers appropriate in a referral under subsection (2), including directions about—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the form any reference determination should take; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: procedural matters.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Trial Division of the Supreme Court or the County Court (as the case requires) to which a referral for a reference determination is made—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must hear and determine the issue or matter in accordance with any directions in the referral; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may otherwise conduct the hearing and determine the procedure for the hearing as it considers appropriate; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: on the determination of the issue or matter, must provide its reference determinations to the Court of Appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal gives leave, the Court of Appeal may hear and determine an appeal against a reference determination as part of the appeal or application for leave to appeal to which the reference determination relates.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Unless the Court of Appeal otherwise determines in accordance with subsection (5), a reference determination is taken to be a determination of the Court of Appeal in the appeal or application for leave to appeal to which the reference determination relates.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A referral under subsection (2) must not be made to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Trial Division of the Supreme Court constituted by a Judge of the Court who was also the trial judge in the proceeding which is the subject of the appeal or application for leave to appeal; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the County Court constituted by a judge who was also the trial judge in the proceeding which is the subject of the appeal or application for leave to appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "319A", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section limits any powers of the Court of Appeal.

heading: Reference of question to special commissioner
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may appoint a special commissioner to inquire into and report on any question referred to the special commissioner by the court if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the question arises on an appeal under this Part or an application for leave to appeal under this Part; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the question involves—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: prolonged examination of documents or accounts; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any scientific or local investigation; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that the examination or investigation cannot conveniently be conducted before the court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court considers that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may act on the report of a special commissioner to the extent that the court considers appropriate to adopt the report.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "320", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may determine the remuneration of a special commissioner.

heading: New evidence—effect on sentence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), on an appeal under this Part, including an appeal by the DPP, the Court of Appeal must not increase a sentence by reason of any evidence that was not given at the trial or sentencing hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 291, the Court of Appeal may increase a sentence by reason of evidence of the failure to fulfil an undertaking referred to in section 291(a).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under this Part, including an appeal by the DPP, the Court of Appeal may increase a sentence, by reason of any evidence that was not given at the trial or sentencing hearing, if the court considers that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the originating court was misled at the sentencing hearing as to a material fact; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an increase in sentence is necessary in the interests of justice.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 321(4) inserted by No. 48/2018 s. 37.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "321", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 327, "rect": {"page": 327, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 455.8, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 494.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 290A, the Court of Appeal may increase a sentence, by reason of any evidence that was not given in the hearing of an appeal under section 254 (an initial appeal), if the court considers that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the County Court or the Trial Division of the Supreme Court, as the case requires, was misled in the initial appeal as to a material fact; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "321", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an increase in sentence is necessary in the interests of justice.

heading: Sentence in absence of offender
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 322 amended by No. 48/2012 s. 8 (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "322", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 327, "rect": {"page": 327, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 625.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 673.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "322", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "322", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may impose a sentence on a person under this Part even though the person does not attend the hearing of an appeal or an application to the Court of Appeal.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 322 amended by No. 65/2011 s. 107(Sch. item 4.6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "322", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 328, "rect": {"page": 328, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 126.7, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "322", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal cannot impose a sentence that requires the consent of the person, for example a community correction order, in the absence of the person.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 322(2) inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 8.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "322", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 328, "rect": {"page": 328, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 215.5, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 254.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "322", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, the making of an order under section 280(3) or 284A(3) is an imposition of a sentence.

heading: Bail following appeal
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "323", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If on an appeal the Court of Appeal orders a new trial or remits a matter to the Trial Division of the Supreme Court or to the County Court, the Court of Appeal may remand the appellant in custody or grant the appellant bail pending the commencement of the new trial or the remitted matter.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 323 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "323", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 328, "rect": {"page": 328, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 385.3, "x1": 126.7, "y1": 424.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "323", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 277(2) requires the Court of Appeal to order that the appellant appear on a specified date for the new trial.

heading: Warrants
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "324", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Part, the Court of Appeal may issue any warrant necessary for enforcing the orders of the court.

heading: Ancillary orders
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 325 (Heading) amended by No. 48/2018 s. 38(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "325", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 328, "rect": {"page": 328, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 499.1, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 547.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "325", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "325", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: ancillary order
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 325(1) def. of ancillary order amended by No. 48/2018 s. 38(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "325", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": "ancillary order", "page": 328, "rect": {"page": 328, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 558.5, "x1": 129.2, "y1": 616.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "325", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "ancillary order"}
text: means an order (other than the order that is the subject of the appeal) made by the originating court in the proceeding or the County Court or the Trial Division of the Supreme Court on an appeal under section 254, as the case requires.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "325", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under this Part, the Court of Appeal may set aside or vary an ancillary order, if the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "325", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal against conviction from the County Court, the Court of Appeal may set aside or vary an order made by the County Court for the suppression of a name.

heading: Expenses of assessors and special commissioners
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "326", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to any prescribed rates and scales of payment, the Attorney-General must pay out of money provided by Parliament all expenses of and incidental to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "326", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appointment of an assessor by the Court of Appeal under section 77 of the Supreme Court Act 1986 in an appeal under this Part;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "326", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a reference of a question to a special commissioner under section 320.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.3", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "326", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Chapter 8 contains general provisions that apply to all criminal proceedings.

heading: Second or subsequent appeal to Court of Appeal
history_json: [{"raw": "Ch. 6 Pt. 6.4 (Headings and ss 326A\u2013 326M) inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "division": null, "part": "6.4", "def_name": null, "page": 330, "rect": {"page": 330, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 125.1, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
