heading: Appeal against conviction
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Right of second or subsequent appeal against conviction
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326A inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 330, "rect": {"page": 330, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 234.5, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 273.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person convicted of an indictable offence by an originating court who—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has exhausted the person's right to appeal against conviction under Division 1 of Part 6.3; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: has previously appealed under this Part but leave to appeal was not granted or the appeal was dismissed, in whole or in part—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may appeal to the Court of Appeal against the conviction if the Court of Appeal gives the person leave to appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definition of originating court in section 3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under subsection (1) may also include an appeal against a conviction for a related summary offence.

heading: How appeal is commenced
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326B inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 330, "rect": {"page": 330, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 520.2, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 559.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326B", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application for leave to appeal under section 326A is commenced by filing a notice of application for leave to appeal in accordance with the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Registrar of Criminal Appeals of the Supreme Court must provide to the respondent a copy of the notice of application for leave to appeal within 7 days after the day on which the notice of application is filed.

heading: Determination of application for leave to appeal under section 326A
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326C inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326C", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 331, "rect": {"page": 331, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may grant leave to appeal under section 326A if it is satisfied that there is fresh and compelling evidence that should, in the interests of justice, be considered on an appeal.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal may grant leave to appeal under section 326A against a conviction for a related summary offence only if it grants leave to appeal under subsection (1) in relation to the indictable offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section, evidence relating to an offence of which a person is convicted is—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: fresh if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it was not adduced at the trial of the offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it could not, even with the exercise of reasonable diligence, have been adduced at the trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: compelling if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is reliable; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is substantial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": "A", "definition": null}
text: it is highly probative in the context of the issues in dispute at the trial of the offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": "B", "definition": null}
text: it would have eliminated or substantially weakened the prosecution case if it had been presented at trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326C", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Evidence that would be admissible on a second or subsequent appeal is not precluded from being fresh or compelling only because it would not have been admissible in the earlier trial of the offence that resulted in the conviction.

heading: Determination of second or subsequent appeal against conviction
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326D inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326D", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 332, "rect": {"page": 332, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 191.2, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326D", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under section 326A, the Court of Appeal must allow the appeal against conviction if it is satisfied that there has been a substantial miscarriage of justice.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In any other case, the Court of Appeal must dismiss an appeal under section 326A.

heading: Orders etc. on successful appeal
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326E inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326E", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 332, "rect": {"page": 332, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 319.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 358.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal allows an appeal under section 326A, it must set aside the conviction of the offence (offence A) and must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: order a new trial of offence A; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: enter a judgment of acquittal of offence A; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the appellant could have been found guilty of some other offence (offence B) instead of offence A; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the jury or, in the case of a plea of guilty to offence A, the trial judge must have been satisfied of facts that prove the appellant was guilty of offence B—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: enter a finding of not guilty of offence B because of mental impairment and make an order or declaration under section 23 of the Crimes (Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be Tried) Act 1997.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: enter a judgment of conviction of offence B and impose a sentence for offence B that is no more severe than the sentence that was imposed for offence A; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the appellant could have been found guilty of some other offence (offence B) instead of offence A and the court is not satisfied as required by paragraph (c)(ii), order a new trial for offence B; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court is satisfied that the appellant should have been found not guilty of offence A because of mental impairment, enter a finding of not guilty because of mental impairment and make an order or declaration under section 23 of the Crimes (Mental Impairment and Unfitness to be Tried) Act 1997; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the appellant could have been found guilty of some other offence (offence B) instead of offence A and the court is satisfied—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the jury must have been satisfied of facts that prove the appellant did the acts or made the omissions that constitute offence B; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the appellant should have been found not guilty of offence B because of mental impairment—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal orders a new trial, the court must order that the appellant attend on a specified date before the court in which the new trial will be conducted.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 326K enables the Court of Appeal to remand the appellant in custody or grant bail pending a new trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal sets aside the conviction of offence A, it may vary a sentence that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: was imposed for an offence other than offence A at or after the time when the appellant was sentenced for offence A; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: took into account the sentence for offence A.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A power of the Court of Appeal under this section to impose a sentence in substitution for the sentence imposed by the originating court may still be exercised even if the sentence imposed by the originating court is an aggregate sentence of imprisonment.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If at the conclusion of an appeal the appellant remains convicted of more than one offence, the Court of Appeal may either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: impose a separate sentence in respect of each offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "326E", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: impose an aggregate sentence of imprisonment in respect of all offences or any 2 or more offences.

heading: Powers and procedure
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Stay of sentence and bail pending appeal
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326F inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326F", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 334, "rect": {"page": 334, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 428.7, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 467.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326F", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a notice of application for leave to appeal is filed under section 326B, the Court of Appeal may stay a sentence if satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A prisoner within the meaning of the Corrections Act 1986 who applies for leave to appeal to the Court of Appeal under this Part may apply to the Court of Appeal to be granted bail.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326F", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application under subsection (2), the Court of Appeal may grant the prisoner bail pending the appeal.

heading: Abandonment of appeal
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326G inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326G", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 334, "rect": {"page": 334, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 612.3, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 651.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326G", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An appeal under this Part may be abandoned in accordance with the rules of court.

heading: Powers which may be exercised by Court of Appeal constituted by a single Judge of Appeal
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326H inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326H", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 335, "rect": {"page": 335, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326H", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Court of Appeal constituted by a single Judge of Appeal may exercise the following powers in this Part—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to give leave to appeal;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to grant the appellant bail;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to order stays of sentence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326H", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court of Appeal constituted by a single Judge of Appeal refuses an application to exercise a power referred to in subsection (1) in relation to any ground of appeal, the applicant is entitled to have the application determined by the Court of Appeal constituted by 2 or more Judges of Appeal.

heading: Application of sections 316 to 320 and 326
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326I inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326I", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 335, "rect": {"page": 335, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 400.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 439.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326I", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 316 to 320 and 326 apply with any necessary modification to a proceeding under this Part.

heading: Sentence in absence of offender
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 326J inserted by No. 44/2019 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "326J", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 335, "rect": {"page": 335, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 467.8, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 506.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "6", "part": "6.4", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "326J", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: When accused etc. is required to appear at hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "329", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "329", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused must appear at every hearing in the criminal proceeding against the accused, unless otherwise provided by this Act or the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "329", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party to an appeal who was the accused in the criminal proceeding to which the appeal relates must appear at every hearing in the appeal, unless otherwise provided by this Act or the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "329", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may excuse a person from appearing at a hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "329", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 328 for the ways in which an accused may appear.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note 2 to s. 329 amended by Nos 69/2009 s. 54(Sch. Pt 2 item 18.2), 38/2016 s. 9(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "329", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": "2", "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 354, "rect": {"page": 354, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 393.6, "x1": 128.4, "y1": 469.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "329", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Division 3 of Part IIA of the Evidence (Miscellaneous 2 Provisions) Act 1958 authorises or requires the appearance of an accused before the court by audio visual link in certain circumstances.

heading: When accused etc. is required to attend hearing
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An accused must attend a hearing in the criminal proceeding against the accused if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: this Act or the rules of court require the attendance of the accused at the hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has been remanded in custody or granted bail to attend the hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court requires the attendance of the accused at the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party to an appeal who was the accused in the criminal proceeding to which the appeal relates must attend a hearing in the appeal if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: this Act or the rules of court require the attendance of the party at the hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the party has been remanded in custody or granted bail to attend the hearing; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court requires the attendance of the party at the hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may excuse a person from attending a hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person fails to attend when required under subsection (1)(a), (1)(b), (2)(a) or (2)(b), the court may issue a warrant to arrest the person.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person fails to attend when required under subsection (1)(c) or (2)(c), the court may issue a warrant to arrest the person if the court is satisfied that the person has had reasonable notice of the requirement to attend.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note 1 to s. 330(5) amended by No. 38/2016 s. 9(4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "330", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": "1", "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 355, "rect": {"page": 355, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 479.3, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 527.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 3 defines attend.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 100(2) provides for the attendance of an accused at hearings in a committal proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "330", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 246 provides for the attendance of an accused at hearings conducted under Chapter 5 (Trial on Indictment).

heading: Power to adjourn proceeding
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A court may adjourn the hearing of a criminal proceeding before the court—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to any time and place; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: for any purpose; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: on any terms as to costs or otherwise—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that it considers appropriate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If at any time a court adjourns the hearing of a criminal proceeding, the court may—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: allow the accused to go at large; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: remand the accused in custody; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: grant the accused bail or extend his or her bail.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 333 of this Act and section 5A of the Bail 1 Act 1977 where the accused is undergoing a sentence of detention in a youth justice centre.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an order is made under paragraph (a) or (c) and the accused is the subject of a youth remand warrant that was issued in another criminal proceeding, the youth remand warrant remains in effect.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused is remanded into custody under paragraph (b), section 6A(2A) of the Corrections Act 1986 provides that the remand order under paragraph (b) takes effect despite the existence of a youth remand warrant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court has adjourned the hearing of a criminal proceeding to a particular time, it may order that the hearing be held or resumed before that time.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A court may only make an order under subsection (3)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: with the consent of all the parties; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: on the application of a party who has given reasonable notice of the application to the other parties.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 331(5) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "331", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 357, "rect": {"page": 357, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court adjourns a criminal proceeding in which a jury has been sworn (by jurors taking an oath or making an affirmation), whether or not the accused is present, the court may discharge the jury from giving a verdict and order a new trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court has adjourned the hearing of a criminal proceeding to a particular time and has remanded the accused in custody, the court may order that the accused be brought at any time before then—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: before the court; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 331(6)(b) amended by Nos 69/2009 s. 54(Sch. Pt 2 item 18.1), 11/2021 s. 47.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "331", "sub_path": ["(6)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 357, "rect": {"page": 357, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 313.6, "x1": 516.8, "y1": 371.1}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:39:38.717941+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: to another place specified in the order where facilities exist to enable the accused to appear before the court by audio visual link—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in order that the hearing may be held or continued.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "331", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The officer in charge of the prison or youth justice centre or other officer who has custody of the accused must obey an order under subsection (6).

heading: Transfer of accused between place of detention and court
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "332", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "332", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A person who has the legal custody of an accused in detention must cause the accused to be brought to and from court whenever necessary so that the accused may be tried, sentenced or otherwise dealt with according to law.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "332", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court considers it in the interests of justice that an accused in detention should be present in court otherwise than for trial, hearing or sentence, the court may order that the accused be brought before the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "332", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a court makes an order under subsection (2), the responsible person, on receiving a copy of the order, must cause the accused to be brought before the court in accordance with the order.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "332", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See the definitions of in detention and responsible person in section 3.

heading: Power to return accused to youth justice centre
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 333(1) amended by No. 43/2017 s. 36(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "333", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 358, "rect": {"page": 358, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 223.8, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 262.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite anything in the Bail Act 1977, if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused in a criminal proceeding in the Magistrates' Court is undergoing a sentence of detention in a youth justice centre; and

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 333(1)(b) amended by No. 5/2025 s. 35.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "333", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 358, "rect": {"page": 358, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 291.0, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 330.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Magistrates' Court adjourns the proceeding or commits the accused for trial—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: direct that the accused be returned to the custody of the Secretary to the Department of Human Services until the end of the sentence of detention or the resumption of the hearing or the commencement of the trial (whichever is the sooner); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court may, subject to subsection (3), instead of remanding the accused in custody—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: either—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 333(1)(d)(i) amended by No. 70/2010 s. 36.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "333", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(d)", "(i)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 358, "rect": {"page": 358, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 480.6, "x1": 124.8, "y1": 519.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: grant the accused bail on a condition that bail is not to be entered until the end of the sentence of detention; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: refuse bail and direct that the accused be brought before the Magistrates' Court at a later date for it to consider the granting of bail.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, the end of the sentence of detention means the time when the accused is released from custody, whether on parole or otherwise.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 5A of the Bail Act 1977 provides equivalent powers to the Supreme Court and the County Court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 333(3) inserted by No. 43/2017 s. 36(2), amended by No. 3/2018 s. 27.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "333", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 359, "rect": {"page": 359, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Secretary to the Department of Justice and Regulation in a criminal proceeding objects to the accused being returned to a youth justice centre under subsection (1), the court may only order that the accused is to be returned to the youth justice centre if the court has considered—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the antecedents and behaviour of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the age and maturity of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any evidence of the behaviour of the accused in custody; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether an application has been made to the Youth Parole Board regarding the custody of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "333", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other relevant factor.

heading: Proceedings against bodies corporate
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this section—

heading: representative
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "representative"}
text: , in relation to a body corporate, means a person duly appointed by the body corporate to represent it for the purpose of doing any act or thing which this section authorises a representative to do.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, a representative need not be appointed under the seal of the body corporate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section, a statement in writing that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: purports to be signed by a managing director of a body corporate or by any person (by whatever name called) having, or being one of the persons having, the management of the affairs of the body corporate; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is to the effect that the person named in the statement has been appointed as the representative of the body corporate for the purposes of this section—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is admissible in evidence and, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, is proof that the person has been so appointed.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A representative may do any act or thing that a natural person may do in a criminal proceeding subject to the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if a body corporate is charged with an indictable offence, a representative may consent to the charge being heard and determined summarily;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if expressly authorised to do so, a representative may plead guilty on behalf of the body corporate;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if expressly authorised to do so, a representative may sign a notice of appeal referred to in section 255 and enter into an undertaking under section 255(5);

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is sufficient if that thing is done in the presence of the representative or said to the representative.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a representative appears in a proceeding against a body corporate for an offence; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "334", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a provision of this Act requires something to be done in the presence of the accused, or to be said to the accused—

heading: Interpreter
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "335", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "335", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person is charged with an offence punishable by imprisonment; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "335", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court is satisfied that the person does not have a knowledge of the English language that is sufficient to enable the person to understand, or participate in, the proceeding—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "335", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the court must not hear and determine the proceeding without a competent interpreter interpreting it.

heading: Subpoenas and witness summonses
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "336", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party to a criminal proceeding may apply for the issue of a subpoena in accordance with the rules of court or a witness summons in accordance with the Magistrates' Court Act 1989, as the case requires.

S. 337 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 38 (ILA s. 39B(1)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "336A", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 361, "rect": {"page": 361, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 556.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 644.4}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:41:07.332468+00:00"}]

heading: Court may act on application or on own motion
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Unless the context otherwise requires, a power or discretion conferred on a court by or under this Act may be exercised by the court on the application of a party or on its own motion.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 337(2) inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 38.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "337", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 362, "rect": {"page": 362, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Unless the context otherwise requires, a power or discretion referred to in subsection (1) includes a power or discretion to revoke or vary a decision or order made in the exercise of that power or discretion.

heading: Court may determine issue in criminal proceeding without oral hearing
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 337A inserted by No. 11/2021 s. 48.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "337A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 362, "rect": {"page": 362, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 232.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 271.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In addition to, and without limiting, section 201, a court may determine any issue (other than determining whether an accused is guilty or not guilty) in any criminal proceeding without an oral hearing and entirely on the basis of written submissions and without the appearance of the parties—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court is satisfied that it is in the interests of justice to do so; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether or not the parties consent to the court doing so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 201 provides for issues to be decided before trial on the basis of written submissions and without the appearance of the parties.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1), in determining whether it is in the interests of justice to determine an issue in a criminal proceeding without an oral hearing, the court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right of an accused to be present at the accused's trial; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the right of an accused to a fair hearing; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of the issue; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the accused or the offender (as the case requires) has had the opportunity to obtain legal advice; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the parties consent to the court doing so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "337A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section affects any other power of the court to determine an issue in a criminal proceeding without an oral hearing.

text: In determining, under subsection (1), whether the evidence has substantial relevance to the issue of appropriate sentence, the court must have regard to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "350", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the probative value of the evidence outweighs the distress, humiliation and embarrassment that the complainant may experience as a result of the cross-examination or the admission of the evidence, in view of the age of the complainant and the number and nature of the questions that the complainant is likely to be asked; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "350", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the need to respect the complainant's personal dignity and privacy.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "350", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 352 limits the relevance of sexual history evidence.

heading: Court must state reasons if leave granted
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 351 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "351", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 369, "rect": {"page": 369, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 628.3, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 667.5}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 351 renumbered as s. 403 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(p).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "351", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 436, "rect": {"page": 436, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 590.2, "x1": 122.8, "y1": 638.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "351", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "351", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court grants leave under section 342 it—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "351", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must state in writing the reasons for granting leave; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "351", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: cause those reasons to be entered in the records of the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "351", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The failure of a court to comply with subsection (1) does not invalidate any order made by it.

heading: Limitation on sexual history evidence
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 352 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "352", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 370, "rect": {"page": 370, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 238.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 277.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 352 renumbered as s. 404 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(q).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "352", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 437, "rect": {"page": 437, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 361.5, "x1": 511.3, "y1": 409.8}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "352", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sexual history evidence is not to be regarded—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "352", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as having a substantial relevance to the facts in issue by virtue of any inferences it may raise as to general disposition; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "352", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as being proper matter for cross-examination as to credit unless, because of special circumstances, it would be likely materially to impair confidence in the reliability of the evidence of the complainant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 353 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "353", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 370, "rect": {"page": 370, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 450.7, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 489.9}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 353 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zz), renumbered as s. 405 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(r).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "353", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 438, "rect": {"page": 438, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 463.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 539.4}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "353", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Division applies to a criminal proceeding that relates (wholly or partly) to a charge for—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "353", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a sexual offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "353", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Definitions
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 354 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "354", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 371, "rect": {"page": 371, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 354 renumbered as s. 406 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(s).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "354", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 439, "rect": {"page": 439, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 256.1, "x1": 511.3, "y1": 304.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
