text: In this Division—

heading: family member
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: , in relation to the complainant or the accused, includes—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: a person who is or has been married to the complainant or the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: a person who has or has had an intimate personal relationship with the complainant or the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: a person who is or has been the parent or step-parent of the complainant or the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: a child who normally or regularly resides with the complainant or the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: a guardian of the complainant or the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family member"}
text: another person who is or has been ordinarily a member of the household of the complainant or the accused;

heading: protected witness
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "protected witness"}
text: means—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "protected witness"}
text: the complainant; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "protected witness"}
text: a family member of the complainant; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "protected witness"}
text: a family member of the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "354", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "protected witness"}
text: any other witness whom the court declares under section 355 to be a protected witness.

heading: Court may declare witness to be protected witness
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 355 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "355", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 371, "rect": {"page": 371, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 614.2, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 653.3}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 355 renumbered as s. 407 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(t).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "355", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 440, "rect": {"page": 440, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 429.5, "x1": 122.8, "y1": 477.9}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "Note to s. 355(2) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 51(zza), renumbered as note to s. 407(2) by No. 68/2009 s. 52(t).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "355", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 441, "rect": {"page": 441, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 257.9}, "confidence": "low"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "355", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may at any time declare a witness to be a protected witness.

heading: Protected witness not to be cross-examined by accused in person
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 356 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "356", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 372, "rect": {"page": 372, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 356 renumbered as s. 408 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(u).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "356", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 441, "rect": {"page": 441, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 325.1, "x1": 511.3, "y1": 373.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "356", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A protected witness must not be cross-examined by the accused in person.

heading: When accused is not legally represented
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 357 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "357", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 372, "rect": {"page": 372, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 224.8, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 263.9}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 357 renumbered as s. 409 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(v).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "357", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 441, "rect": {"page": 441, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 419.9, "x1": 511.3, "y1": 468.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is not legally represented, the court must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: inform the accused and the jury (if any) that the accused is not permitted personally to cross-examine a protected witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: ask the accused whether the accused has sought legal representation for the cross-examination of a protected witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if satisfied that the accused has not had a reasonable opportunity to obtain legal representation, grant an adjournment if so requested by the accused.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused does not obtain legal representation for the cross-examination of a protected witness (after being given a reasonable opportunity to do so), the court must order Victoria Legal Aid to provide legal representation for the accused for that purpose.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite anything in the Legal Aid Act 1978, Victoria Legal Aid must provide legal representation in accordance with an order under subsection (2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A legal practitioner provided by Victoria Legal Aid must act in the best interests of the accused if the accused does not give any instructions to that legal practitioner.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 357(5) amended by Nos 5/2018 s. 28, 1/2022 s. 125.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "357", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 373, "rect": {"page": 373, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "357", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to any direction given under section 389E(2)(f), if the accused refuses the legal representation provided under subsection (3), or otherwise refuses to co-operate, the court must warn the accused that the accused will not be permitted to adduce evidence in relation to a fact in issue in order to contradict the evidence of a protected witness unless the evidence on which the accused intends to rely has been put to the protected witness during cross-examination.

heading: Jury warning concerning legal representation for cross-examination
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 358 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "358", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 373, "rect": {"page": 373, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 301.6, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 340.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 358 renumbered as s. 410 by No. 68/2009 s. 52(w).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "358", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 441, "rect": {"page": 441, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 600.5, "x1": 511.3, "y1": 648.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "358", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the accused is only legally represented for the cross-examination of a protected witness, the trial judge must warn the jury—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "358", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that it is routine practice for an unrepresented accused to obtain or be provided with legal representation for the cross-examination of a protected witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "358", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that no adverse inference may be drawn against the accused as a result of the cross-examination not being conducted by the accused in person; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "3", "subdivision": null, "section": "358", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the evidence given under cross-examination is not to be given any greater or lesser weight as a result of the cross-examination not being conducted by the accused in person.

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "5", "subdivision": null, "section": "368", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 368A inserted by No. 48/2012 s. 23.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "368A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 382, "rect": {"page": 382, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: Sections 211 and 212 impose time limits for commencing trials for offences.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 371(1B) inserted by No. 5/2025 s. 21(3), amended by No. 1/2026 s. 76(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "371", "sub_path": ["(1B)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 385, "rect": {"page": 385, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 634.0, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 700.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "371", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: if the complainant is cognitively impaired, the severity of that impairment; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "371", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "372", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: The room in which the complainant gives evidence is taken to be part of the courtroom while the complainant is there for the purpose of giving evidence.

heading: Form in which recording of special hearing is to be tendered
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 373 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "373", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 388, "rect": {"page": 388, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 218.8, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 257.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "373", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 373(1) amended by No. 48/2012 s. 28.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "373", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 388, "rect": {"page": 388, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 272.2, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 311.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "373", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A recording of a special hearing that is tendered as evidence by the prosecution must be the best available record, or be comprised of the best available records, of the evidence of the complainant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "373", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In subsection (1)— the best available record of the evidence, or any part of the evidence, means an audiovisual recording of the evidence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "373", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In exceptional circumstances and having regard to whether the accused would be unfairly prejudiced, the court may admit as evidence an audio recording of the evidence, or any part of the evidence, if an audiovisual recording of the evidence is not available.

heading: Admissibility of evidence from special hearing
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 374 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "374", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 388, "rect": {"page": 388, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 503.2, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 542.3}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 374(1) amended by No. 48/2012 s. 28.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "374", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 388, "rect": {"page": 388, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 562.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 601.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: In this section—

heading: recording
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "recording"}
text: means a recording of a special hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (3), a recording is admissible in evidence as if its contents were the direct testimony of the complainant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the proceeding; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: unless the relevant court otherwise orders, in—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any new trial of, or appeal from, the proceeding; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 374(2)(b)(ii) substituted by No. 5/2025 s. 23.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "374", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)", "(ii)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 389, "rect": {"page": 389, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 224.8, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 263.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: another proceeding in the same court for—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 374 (2)(b)(ii)(A) amended by No. 1/2026 s. 77.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "374", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 389, "rect": {"page": 389, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 278.2, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 326.4}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:54:11.319048+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": "A", "definition": null}
text: the charge for the sexual offence, the family violence offence or the offence against section 21A(1) of the Crimes Act 1958 (stalking) (as the case requires); or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": "B", "definition": null}
text: a charge for a related offence; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 374(2)(b)(iii) substituted by No. 5/2025 s. 23, amended by No. 1/2026 s. 77.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "374", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(b)", "(iii)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 389, "rect": {"page": 389, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 373.0, "x1": 517.8, "y1": 439.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "iii", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a civil proceeding arising from the same facts as those on which the charge for the sexual offence, the family violence offence or the offence against section 21A(1) of the Crimes Act 1958 (stalking) is founded.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may rule as inadmissible the whole or any part of the contents of a recording and, if so, the court may direct that the recording be edited or altered to delete any part of it that is inadmissible.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A party may apply for a ruling under subsection (3): section 337.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (3), the whole of a recording must be heard by the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The admissibility of a recording of the evidence of a person under the age of 18 years is not affected only because the person attains the age of 18 years before the evidence is presented in a proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "374", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to section 376(3), if under this section a recording is admitted into evidence in a proceeding, the complainant is not required to attend the proceeding unless required to do so for cross-examination or re-examination.

heading: Cross-examination of complainant
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 376 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "376", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 390, "rect": {"page": 390, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 391.0, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 430.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A complainant whose evidence is recorded under section 370 cannot be cross-examined or re-examined without leave.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A court must not grant leave to cross-examine a complainant referred to in subsection (1) unless the court is satisfied that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused is seeking leave because of becoming aware of a matter of which the accused could not reasonably have been aware at the time of the recording; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the complainant were giving direct testimony in the proceeding, the complainant could be recalled, in the interests of justice, to give further evidence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is otherwise in the interests of justice to permit the complainant to be cross-examined or re-examined.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If leave is granted under subsection (2), the complainant must attend the proceeding to be cross-examined or re-examined.

history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 377 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50, substituted as Note by No. 37/2017 s. 14.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "377", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 391, "rect": {"page": 391, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 205.0, "x1": 517.3, "y1": 280.9}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-09-22T10:54:59.589782+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "6", "subdivision": null, "section": "376", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 377 previously provided an exception to the hearsay rule in relation to previous representations made by a complainant under 18 years in certain circumstances. This matter is now provided for in section 66 of the Evidence Act 2008.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "378", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "378", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 383 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "383", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 394, "rect": {"page": 394, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "383", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 384 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "384", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 394, "rect": {"page": 394, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 252.4, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 291.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "384", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "384", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "384", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "384", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Cross-examination of complainant
history_json: [{"raw": "New s. 385 inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "385", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 394, "rect": {"page": 394, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 482.9, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 522.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "385", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "385", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to section 384(2), if a recording of the evidence of the complainant is admitted into evidence in a proceeding, the complainant cannot be cross-examined or re-examined without leave.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "385", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "385", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7", "subdivision": null, "section": "386", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "Pt 8.2 Div. 7B (Heading and ss 387C\u2013 387P) inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": "7B", "part": "8.2", "def_name": null, "page": 398, "rect": {"page": 398, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 406.6, "x1": 126.3, "y1": 473.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": null, "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Definitions
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387C inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387C", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 398, "rect": {"page": 398, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 484.3, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 523.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In this Division—

heading: family violence offence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family violence offence"}
text: means—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family violence offence"}
text: an offence against section 37(2), 37A(2), 123(2), 123A(2) or 125A(1) of the Family Violence Protection Act 2008; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "family violence offence"}
text: an offence where the conduct of the accused is family violence within the meaning of that Act;

heading: recorded statement
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "recorded statement"}
text: means an audiovisual or audio recording of a complainant answering questions put to the complainant by a trained police officer;

heading: trained police officer
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": "trained police officer"}
text: means a police officer who has successfully completed a training course approved by the Chief Commissioner of Police under subsection (2).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387C", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Chief Commissioner of Police may approve one or more training courses for police officers for the purposes of this Division.

heading: Application of Division
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387D inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387D", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 399, "rect": {"page": 399, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 327.4, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 366.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387D", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Division applies to a criminal proceeding (including a summary hearing, a committal proceeding and a trial) that relates (wholly or partly) to a charge for a family violence offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 387J and 387K apply to other proceedings.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: However, this Division does not apply if the accused was under the age of 18 years at the time the family violence offence is alleged to have been committed.

heading: Use of recorded statement as complainant's evidence-in-chief
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387E inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387E", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 399, "rect": {"page": 399, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 504.5, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 543.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A complainant may give evidence-in-chief (wholly or partly) in the form of a recorded statement in accordance with this Division.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387E(2) amended by No. 1/2026 s. 81.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387E", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 399, "rect": {"page": 399, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 585.5, "x1": 511.8, "y1": 624.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In determining whether or not to have a complainant give evidence wholly or partly in the form of a recorded statement, the prosecution must take into account—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the wishes of the complainant; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any evidence of intimidation of the complainant by the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the purpose of the Family Violence Protection Act 2008.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The purpose of the Family Violence Protection Act 2008 is set out in section 1 of that Act.

heading: Admissibility of recorded evidence-in-chief
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387F inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387F", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 400, "rect": {"page": 400, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 237.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 276.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to this Division, a recorded statement referred to in section 387E is admissible in evidence as if its contents were the direct testimony of the complainant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the proceeding; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: unless the relevant court otherwise orders, in any new trial of, or appeal from, the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (4), a recorded statement is admissible under subsection (1) if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the recorded statement complies with section 387G; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (3), a copy or transcript of the recorded statement was served in accordance with section 387H; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (3), the court is satisfied that, if the accused is not represented by a legal practitioner, the accused was given a reasonable opportunity to—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: view the recorded statement if it is in the form of an audiovisual recording; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: listen to the recorded statement if it exists only in the form of an audio recording and the accused has not been served with a copy of it; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: at the hearing of the proceeding, the complainant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: identifies himself or herself and attests to the truthfulness of the contents of the recorded statement; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is available for cross-examination and re-examination.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A recorded statement is admissible under subsection (1) despite non-compliance with subsection (2)(b) or (c) if the parties consent to its use as the complainant's evidence-in-chief.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court may rule as inadmissible the whole or any part of the content of a recorded statement and, if so, the court may direct that the recorded statement be edited or otherwise altered to delete any part that is inadmissible.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting what is a reasonable opportunity for the purposes of subsection (2)(c), a reasonable opportunity is taken to have been given if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused was given an opportunity to view or listen to the recorded statement, as referred to in subsection (2)(c), while being questioned in relation to the alleged family violence offence; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387F", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the informant notified the accused in writing that the accused had the right to view or listen to the recorded statement, as referred to in subsection (2)(c), on a day arranged with the informant.

heading: Requirements for making recorded statement
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387G inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387G", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 402, "rect": {"page": 402, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 120.1, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: To be admissible as evidence-in-chief under section 387F, a recorded statement—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must be made—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: as soon as practicable after the events constituting the alleged family violence offence to which the statement relates occurred; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: with the complainant's informed consent; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: must include, at the end of the recording, an attestation by the complainant as to the truth of the content of the statement; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (2), must be in the form of an audiovisual recording.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In exceptional circumstances and having regard to whether the accused would be unfairly prejudiced, the court may admit as evidence-in-chief a recorded statement in the form of an audio recording, if an audiovisual recording of the statement is not available.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A recorded statement is made with informed consent if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the trained police officer informs the complainant that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the recorded statement may be used in evidence in a criminal proceeding, a proceeding for a family violence intervention order or, if a court or tribunal orders, another proceeding; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the complainant may be required to give further evidence in the proceeding, including further evidence-in-chief and evidence on cross-examination and re-examination; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the complainant may refuse consent to the making of the recorded statement; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the complainant indicates in the recorded statement that the complainant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: understands the matters referred to in paragraph (a); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: consents to the making of the recorded statement.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If any part of a recorded statement is in a language other than English—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the recorded statement must contain an oral translation of the part into English; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387G", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a separate written English translation of the part must accompany the recorded statement.

heading: Service of recorded statement
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 387H inserted by No. 33/2018 s. 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "387H", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 403, "rect": {"page": 403, "x0": 467.8, "y0": 440.2, "x1": 508.5, "y1": 479.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A recorded statement must be served on the accused or the accused's legal practitioner in accordance with Part 3.2, Part 4.4 or Part 5.5, as the case requires, subject to the following modifications—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is represented by a legal practitioner, the legal practitioner must be served with an audiovisual copy of the recorded statement (or an audio copy if the statement is in audio form) but must not give a copy of the recorded statement to the accused or allow the accused to be given, or take a copy of, the recorded statement;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the accused is not represented by a legal practitioner, the accused must be served with—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: an audio copy of the recorded statement (whether the recorded statement is in audio or audiovisual form); or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the circumstances described in subsection (2), a transcript of the recorded statement.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (1)(b)(ii), an accused is to be served with a transcript rather than an audio copy only if the informant or prosecutor believes that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: serving an audio copy on the accused would be likely to present a reasonably ascertainable risk that the accused would commit an offence under section 387L(1) or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the particular circumstances of the accused, a transcript is required.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An example for subsection (2)(b) is where an accused is hearing impaired and would not be able to listen to an audio copy of the recorded statement.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in relation to the recorded statement; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "8", "part": "8.2", "division": "7B", "subdivision": null, "section": "387H", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
